others.title: Best Buy Announces Midnight Opening for Ocarina of Time Launch, Zelda Switch 2 Consoles Also Up for Grabs

content.v: Back almost three decades ago, digital storefronts didn't exist for home consoles. So when The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time originally launched on Nintendo 64 in 1998, the only way to get the game early was showing up at a retail store at midnight (something my dad actually did because I was only 12 years old at the time).

Best Buy wants to recreate that feeling with the announcement of late-night store openings for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's launch on Switch 2 next month. In fact, people who have already preordered the remake can even change their order to pick it up in-store at midnight on November 5. Keep in mind that this includes standing in line outside a Best Buy instead of just waiting for delivery at your doorstep.

In addition, the Best Buy midnight launch will have something for people who haven't preordered the game. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time will be available for purchase, but maybe more importantly, the special 40th-anniversary Zelda Switch 2 system and Switch 2 Pro Controller will be available in limited quantities, too. That should be exciting since the Zelda-themed console sold out almost immediately last month.

Nintendo showed off the first gameplay footage for the Ocarina of Time remake in September, and it looks fantastic. The game features a total visual overhaul, which hasn't gone over well with everyone (they're wrong, by the way). The Switch 2 exclusive also has eight other big changes from the original title, including the ability to jump at any time . That sounds funny, but it's sort of a big deal.

items.summary: 今日，尊界汽车官方发布公告回应了最近关于尊界汽车制动踏板支架底座相关的问题。

content.v: 今日，尊界汽车官方发布公告回应了最近关于尊界汽车制动踏板支架底座相关的问题。
此前，有账号指出百万豪车尊界V800汽车，出现刹车踏板断裂现象，相关话题引发极大关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082324128221.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082324168077.png
公告原文：
制动系统直接关系用户的出行安全，我们高度重视相关视频引发的关切。
尊界汽车的制动系统，按照高于国家标准（GB 21670‑2025 / GB 7258‑2026）、高于行业标准（QC/T 788‑2018）的要求完成全流程开发与验证。自首批车辆交付以来，在用户实际使用场景中，未发生制动踏板支架底座断裂故障。
用户安全永远是我们的第一优先级。即便是非标准的极端测试工况，我们仍希望为用户提供更高的安全冗余：我们将进一步优化该部件设计，并为已交付用户提供免费升级选择。
同时，我们将对相关部件的设计验证、试验边界与生产质量管理开展系统性复核与补强，持续完善我们的安全体系。感谢广大用户对尊界汽车的关注与监督。

items.title: How to complete Boarding the Frigate in Arc Raiders
items.summary: Find a way onto the flying Arc Frigate.

content.v: ⚡Climb onto one of the drones the frigate spits out and interact to disrupt it.
⚡Ride it up to the Arc Frigate.
⚡Damage a Rocketeer, Vaporizer, and Hydra turret to complete the quest.

Arc Raiders ' new Boarding the Frigate quest is about finding a way up onto the giant flying Arc fortress during the new Arc Frigate map modifier. Since this is a colossal arc event, you'll want to bring plenty of ammo and healing. A Grappling or Snap Hook will come in handy, too.

You can get onto the frigate (as shown in the video) by finding one of the circular Arc drones that it spits out when it arrives on the map, climbing or grappling on top of it, and then interacting with it to disrupt the drone. This will cause it to fly back to the frigate, allowing you to climb aboard.

The ship is absolutely massive, and as you make your way through it with other raiders, it'll spit out Rocketeers, Vaporizers, and Hydra turrets will pop out on the top level as well. To finish off the quest, you'll have to damage all three, though you don't have to get the killing blow on any of them. Rocketeers and Vaporizers (if you somehow haven't encountered them before) are big flying arcs that fire rockets and lasers, respectively, while the Hydra is a multigun turret that's pretty deadly.

Presumably, you can also damage these enemies elsewhere to complete this step, though I haven't encountered a Hydra anywhere else except on top of the frigate so far, so that's likely your best bet. If you're struggling to navigate the ship, you can open new platforms with switches and by shooting the yellow nodes sticking out, though a Grappling Hook will also help skip some stages.

items.title: Tekken 8’s Reina Teased as the Next Guest Character for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
items.summary: Reina, who made her debut in Tekken 8, is coming to Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves. The announcement comes fro

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/reina-1791472008230.webp
Reina, who made her debut in Tekken 8 , is coming to Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves . The announcement comes from a short teaser trailer from SNK Official.

The Tekken fighter joins the City of the Wolves roster as a playable character, joining other guest characters such as Street Fighter’s Chun-Li, Fist of the North Star’s Kenshiro, and soccer star Christiano Ronaldo. Reina is believed to be the daughter of Heihachi Mishima, a guy with a penchant for chucking his kids into volcanos. It’s no wonder she’s looking for somewhere else to live.

Tekken 7 previously featured Geese Howard, one of the primary antagonists of Fatal Fury, as a guest character, so it’s nice to see Bandai Namco paying the favor back. Fatal Fury has gone a bit ham with the guest characters, but this one definitely makes more sense than that soccer player who dives for a living.

The trailer doesn’t give much away, but it’ll be interesting to see how Reina’s Mishima School fighting style gets translated into Fatal Fury. This announcement nips the heels of the Manjiro Sano and Ken Ryuguji (Season Pass 3 – fourth DLC character) trailers, also released today. Both Sano and Ryuguji, who originate from manga series Tokyo Revengers, arrive in South Town on October 22.

Reina is expected to hit City of the Wolves in December, after Laocorn is released in November. Reina also continues City of the Wolves' guest DLC character run after Sano's announcement sparked a debate in the Fatal Fury community about guest fighters .

IGN’s Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves review called it “a wonderful update to the classic SNK style of one-on-one combat that feels similar to Street Fighter 6, but just different enough to exist as an alternative to it.”

Eagle-eyed players had already predicted the inclusion of Reina, noting the purple color of Season 3 fitted with the character’s aesthetic. In the teaser trailer, she appears only as a silhouette in the background.
Reina is considered a hard character to master in Tekken 8, thanks to her diverse moveset and her weak lows. Advanced players make up for it by utilizing her unbreakable throws and stance changes.
The character’s pick rate in Tekken 8 Ranked is 3.1% and she has a 46% win rate. It remains to be seen whether she’s as deep and divisive in City of the Wolves.

items.summary: Best Buy is opening select stores at midnight on Nov. 5 for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time launch day, f

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/zelda-ocarina-of-time-switch-2-console-best-buy-1791470838410.png

Best Buy has announced it will be opening select stores at midnight for the launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The major US retailer is gearing up for the highly anticipated release, with its website also now featuring a countdown to November 5.
The midnight launch will also include a fresh batch of stock for the limited-edition Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Switch 2 consoles and matching Switch 2 Pro controllers.
That's potentially good news for anyone who missed out on the special-edition console during the preorder excitement in September .

For now, Best Buy hasn't specified how many systems will be available or which stores will receive stock, but it has warned that quantities are limited. Best Buy has also said that store hours will vary depending on region, so you'll want to check with your local store before heading out.

If you already have an Ocarina of Time preorder set for shipping and would prefer to collect it during the midnight opening, Best Buy has said you can also do this by modifying your order through your "Best Buy purchase history".
There is a good reason for fans to preorder elsewhere, however, as both Amazon and Walmart have Ocarina of Time listed for $59.88 instead of $69.99 .
The special edition Switch 2 console and accessories was shown off during the dedicated Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Direct last month.
They will be available from October 29, but are currently sold out at every major retailer in the U.S .
Other highlights in the Nintendo Direct included the first gameplay reveal for Ocarina of Time , as well as a release date.
This is a full remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 original game, with overhauled graphics that bring it up to modern standards.
According to Nintendo, this is a "faithful interpretation" for new hardware, but it does have a few more lines of dialogue for the characters you meet along the way, to give them more personality.

items.title: GTA 6：Rockstar 发布全新官方截图，展示令人惊叹的倒影
items.summary: Rockstar has released three brand new GTA 6 screenshots alongside its radio station reveal.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/huhrrx9xaaa-x6a-1791470923038.jpg
Rockstar has released three brand new GTA 6 screenshots alongside its radio station reveal.

The screenshots offer a wide view of the game, showing off day and nightlife. Each features the density of objects we've come to expect from GTA 6 assets. The screenshot of the freeway, for example, shows dozens of vehicles going about their business, with birds and a plane flying overhead. The shot of a car meet shows impressive lighting as NPCs mingle (look carefully at the top right of that one and you'll see an NPC digging through a trash bin).

But fans are praising one of the images in particular: the nighttime screenshot which shows reflections in puddles, all lit up by the neon lights of the nearby hotel. GTA 6, let’s remember, launches on consoles only next month, including the less powerful Xbox Series S right up to the PS5 Pro, and Rockstar has yet to confirm performance specs. Rockstar didn't say which console the new screenshots were captured from either.

The new screenshots arrive as part of Rockstar’s confirmation of a handful of the radio stations that will be in GTA 6 , as well as some of the celebrity hosts who appear on them. The reveal also follows hot on the heels of the return of GTA 6 leaker ‘Cyberleek,’ who today released a 24-minute gameplay video showing unauthorized footage.

We’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 for you to chew on, including our big GTA 6 interview . Some of the detail in that set tongues wagging across the internet this week, so we’ve stepped in to clear up the speculation .

content.v: 近日，日本日美混血女星玉城蒂娜卷入网传私密影片外流风波，而她参演的新剧即将于16日开播，事件时间点十分敏感，迅速引爆日本社交平台与各大论坛。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082242311072.png
现年29岁的玉城蒂娜凭借《极道主夫》收获大量人气。事件从5日晚间开始发酵，相关话题迅速登上热搜，浏览量短时间内突破数百万。网传说法称该视频为五年前拍摄、高价交易的私密素材。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082242409593.png
但大量网友比对细节后提出诸多疑点，结合当下AI技术普及现状，不少人判断这是利用她公开社交照片合成的伪造视频。伴随话题扩散，网络诈骗乱象同步滋生：大量机器人账号打着“免费完整版”的幌子散播钓鱼链接，企图盗取个人信息与钱财。甚至还有伪造的事务所否认声明图在网络流传，误导大众。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082242493994.png
玉城蒂娜已于2024年官宣结婚，恰逢新剧开播在即，网友对事件背后动机猜测不断，恶意抹黑、报复乃至炒作等说法层出不穷。目前玉城蒂娜本人及其经纪公司暂未发布任何官方回应。

items.title: Xbox’s XP Is A Fancy New Name, But We’re Failing To See What’s Really Different Here
items.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma continues to reshape the gaming brand, this time with the new XP division . The clever mo

content.v: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma continues to reshape the gaming brand, this time with the new XP division . The clever moniker works for Xbox pictures, products, places, and partnerships--the "four investment areas" now overseen by Kayleen Walters (who previously was Mojang Studios president). This all seems like a bigger push into TV, film, and maybe even theme parks for Xbox . But upon closer inspection, there really isn't anything new here, at least not yet.

There's nothing about new investments in movies and TV shows with this announcement. There isn't even the reveal of a new game adaptation for the silver or small screen. Instead, there's a lot of celebrating what's been around or in production for years, such as the Call of Duty movie and Fallout: Season 3 . We also know A Minecraft Movie Squared is on the way (which should have been called A Nether Minecraft Movie).

In fact, Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball basically admits on Xbox Wire that all of this stuff was already happening at the company: "It brings together capabilities that have existed across various teams at Xbox for years and aligns them behind a shared mission: helping our franchises reach more people, create deeper connections with players and new fans, and unlock new opportunities for these fandoms to grow around the world."

Maybe this new department will lead to better returns and more Hollywood movies from Xbox in the future. But right now, it seems like reshuffling the same deck of cards. It's hard not to shake the feeling this is a PR play as an outsider looking in, especially as Xbox continues to close studios and enact mass layoffs .

This also comes days after Sharma reportedly claimed Xbox has "started to return to growth" at a town-hall meeting, without providing any evidence. Then, just today, Circana reported that Xbox hardware unit sales in the US fell 31% this past August when compared to August 2025--and were the lowest since August 2020.

items.title: GTA 6 在发布前透露了一些广播电台、DJ 和歌曲
items.summary: Rockstar Games has launched a new website which allows you to listen to some of the radio stations and songs t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/huhrrqdweaall9w-1791470229549.jpg
Rockstar Games has launched a new website which allows you to listen to some of the radio stations and songs that will be featured in GTA 6 .

Rockstar said GTA 6 will feature the "biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet," and, as always, has hired a number of celebrities such as Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey to host the stations. As for some of the things you'll be able to listen to, here are all of the stations and some of the songs that Rockstar has revealed so far.
Every Confirmed Radio Station in GTA 6 So Far

Cocoteo FM: Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo (voiced by Bad Bunny) and La Gata (voiced by RaiNao) and featuring everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton – Cocoteo FM is el party que nunca se apaga .
Songs featured:

Back Country Radio: MW (voiced by Morgan Wallen) and Delta Dawne (voiced by Lana Del Rey) blast renegade country music to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. Stay tuned for Back Country’s roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta’s not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike (voiced by Jeremy Dufrene) checking in from the driver’s seat of his Grassrivers airboat.
Songs featured:

AfroBank FM: Turn up the gbedu with Burna (voiced by Burna Boy) and Palmsy (voiced by Palms Trax), AfroBank FM's dynamic duo curating the best in African music, from 20th-century classics and undiscovered gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more.
Songs featured:

The Chamber 106.6: Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. Jump in the pit with DJ Kerry (voiced by Kerry King) and DJ Tom (voiced by Tom Araya) for classic metal from the ‘80s and beyond as they channel Leonida’s deep metal roots.
Songs featured:

Flash FM: The Vice City institution that delivers the best in pop music with Robyn (voiced by herself) and Alex (voiced by Alex Consani) — guaranteed to make you dance no matter where you find yourself in the Goodtime State.
Songs featured:

Dirty South Classics: A little southern hospitality from Trick (voiced by Trick Daddy) and Trina (voiced by herself), blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics. From the beach to the block, nobody reps Leonida and the South like they do.
Songs featured:

This small selection does confirm there will be a wide variety of music, as some of the music featured includes the likes of Charli XCX, Bad Bunny, MGMT, DJ Khaled, and Black Sabbath. It's unclear if Rockstar will reveal the entire list of tracks in GTA 6 before launch, but this does provide a pretty good idea of what we'll be getting on November 19.

Additionally, Rockstar released a small batch of new screenshots and confirmed that GTA 6 will feature the ability to listen to on-demand podcasts and radio stations on foot by using a pair of headphones and your smartphone. This is a massive feature that fans have wanted for years, as the radio has previously been confined to your vehicles and inside of select buildings. However, now players will be able to listen to music freely when they're in combat, exploring on foot, and more.

In September, Rockstar Games confirmed that it will release an album comprised of original music, made for GTA 6. So far, Rockstar has confirmed original songs from Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Keith Richards, and more. The entire tracklist has yet to be revealed, but it wouldn't be surprising if we hear more about the album later this month or early November ahead of the game's launch.

All of this news is coming just hours after 25 minutes of new GTA 6 gameplay leaked on the internet . The new footage comes from Cyberleek, who was responsible for leaking a ton of GTA gameplay in August. Rockstar has yet to respond to the new footage, but is likely hoping that the news around the game's radio station serves as an ample distraction.

IGN also posted a full transcript of its interview with Rob Nelson, the studio co-head of Rockstar North . Nelson demoed GTA 6 for IGN earlier this summer and revealed a variety of new information regarding the game in our conversation with him.
GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.

items.title: “几乎不值得成为第二”——直播服务如何将游戏变成争夺头把交椅的大逃杀
items.summary: The live-service trend has brought us some amazing games, but the chase for money-printing success means devel

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/05/the-present-of-live-service-games-blogroll-1791198870991.jpg

Before there was Warzone, Fortnite, or even PUBG: Battlegrounds, there was Minecraft Survival Games. While the exact origin is nebulous, Norwegian YouTuber Dennis Vaeride is credited as launching the first Survival Games server in April 2012, just one month after The Hunger Games’ film adaptation had opened in cinemas. The concept followed the rules outlined in Katniss’ harrowing ordeal: dozens of players would sprint into the middle of a starting circle, gather supplies, and then hunt until the last one standing.

Little did Vaeride know, he’d just fired the starting pistol on an industry-wide battle royale. Many studios would try to replicate this formula. Few would survive. Those that did would grow fat on microtransactions and spiralling player counts.

The Past, Present, and Future of Live-Service Live-service is one of the biggest issues in gaming. Is it a curse destined to destroy studios, or the key to the industry's survival? With expert insight from veteran developers, including Overwatch's Jeff Kaplan and Anthem's Mark Darrah, IGN exlores the long timeline of live-service games across three detailed articles. Combining interviews, analysis, and opinion, this is the past, present, and future of gaming's most divisive trend.

Last year the market for the battle royale sub-genre was valued at $11.2 billion. It is expected to reach nearly $30 billion by 2035 . Everyone’s chasing the money and almost all of them are discovering just how difficult it is to carve out their own piece of the pie – even heavyweights like Halo Studios and monied companies like Amazon Games have failed miserably. It’s a financial frenzy that can be traced all the way back to those Hunger Games-inspired Minecraft servers… although the true spark that set the industry ablaze came a year later, from a single developer living in Brazil.

In early 2013, Brendan Greene had an idea for a DayZ mod (the zombie survival game that was itself a mod of mil-sim ARMA, and was already responsible for whipping the survival genre into a frenzy on PC). Inspired not by The Hunger Games but by Kinji Fukasaku’s similarly themed 2000 thriller, Battle Royale, Greene’s idea was a last-player-standing multiplayer mode that took place on a large map scattered with weapons and restricted by a shrinking circular safe area. He developed what became PlayerUnknown's Battle Royale over a number of years, and his association with the format became so significant that Sony brought him on as a consultant whilst developing the competing H1Z1.

But Sony wasn’t the only major studio that took notice of Greene’s rise. South Korean studio Bluehole offered him the chance to create his own project. That game was PlayerUnknown Battlegrounds – a 100-player last-man-standing shooter with random loot drops and an ever-decreasing map size. The game launched on Steam Early Access in March 2017. By December, it had over three million concurrent players. Everyone took notice of Greene’s success – including Epic Games.

Fortnite was not always the battle royale you know today. When it launched in July 2017, it was a struggling tower defence game where a quartet of players scavenged and built fortifications to defend against waves of nocturnal monsters. PUBG’s meteoric success convinced Epic’s CEO and CCO, Tim Sweeney and Donald Mustard, to take a gamble on improving Fortnite’s future: they quickly tasked the team to develop their own equivalent of PlayerUnknown’s formula.

By September, the mode was released. It was barebones, practically ramshackle, with minimal assets and a bizarre application of the building systems from the original fort-crafting mode. But it had one secret weapon. Unlike PUBG, Fortnite: Battle Royale was free-to-play. The most popular video game idea in the world was suddenly free for all. Within 2 weeks, it hit 10 million players. Within a year, it was home to 125 million. Today, the number of registered Fortnite players sits at 650 million.

The battle royale pivot changed Fortnite forever. It isn’t even a game anymore – it’s become a platform, one where Ariana Grande and Eminem have performed virtually, previews of Star Wars movies have played, and servers worldwide were shut down to emulate a world-ending event.
It’s Happened Before, It Will Happen Again

PUBG and Fortnite’s dual success created a video games arms race: nearly 2,000 games have been assigned the “battle royale” tag on Steam, while hundreds more exist in the mobile gaming market. When you have a game that made $9 billion within two years and likely over $20 billion by now, it’s clear to see why so many publishers have tried to replicate its formula.

This is, of course, an echo of one of the original live-service booms from half a decade earlier: the MOBA. Another genre that grew out of a mod, the industry was captivated by the 5v5 “battle arena”, with dozens of studios attempting to replicate the success of Riot’s League of Legends and Valve’s Dota 2 . Dozens of MOBAs were quickly developed and died almost as fast, and the same cycle could be seen with battle royale. Ubisoft’s Hyper Scape , Square Enix’s Final Fantasy 7: The First Soldier , Fallout 76’s Nuclear Winter expansion – even Epic itself couldn’t emulate its own success, with wrestling battle royale Rumbleverse flatlining less than a year after launch.

Some may claim the widespread failure to truly compete with PUBG and Fortnite is down to studios failing to innovate on Greene’s original concepts. But, as with the MOBA craze, a massively over-saturated marketplace may be the stronger prevailing reason. It’s a situation ex-BioWare producer Mark Darrah, who worked on looter shooter Anthem , knows well.

“You have to believe that you can actually dethrone one of the top two players in that genre, or you shouldn’t be doing it,” he says. For Darrah, that meant stealing the crown from Destiny – a task that the single-player RPG experts at BioWare weren’t suited to. Anthem struggled right from the moment it launched. Destiny remained on the throne.

But there’s more to that story. BioWare wasn’t just competing with Destiny – it was going up against a Destiny that had enjoyed half a decade of development, refinement, and a sequel. That’s an issue facing any developer getting into the live-service space in 2026 – the table stakes for new video games are radically different to even just 10 years ago. As Overwatch’s original lead director Jeff Kaplan puts it: “If someone wanted to make a MOBA today, they’re not competing with the likes of League of Legends five years in. They’re competing with League up to today.”
The Poisoned Chalice of Live-Service Success

Overwatch , the live-service game that triggered the hero shooter craze, was not planned. Kaplan was given an ultimatum after his previous MMORPG project fell apart: give us an idea within a month or the team gets disbanded.

Kaplan feels that pressure created an intense creativity boost amongst the team, both during the initial concepting and development of the 6v6 hero shooter, and beyond into its live years. The game “caught and rode the [audience] wave”, describes Kaplan, who compares it to World of Warcraft’s similar success.

items.title: “很难证明投资的合理性”——MMORPG 如何建立（和失去）直播服务王座
items.summary: How MMORPGs like World of Warcraft and EverQuest started the industry's obsession with never-ending live-servi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/05/the-past-of-live-service-games-blogroll-1791196766001.jpg

Whatever happened to the MMORPG? In the early 2000s, the likes of World of Warcraft, RuneScape, and EverQuest dominated cyberspace, their worlds host to millions of players questing and raiding together. Today, Roblox’s titanic 123 million daily player count dwarfs the combined historical peak of this trio and many other genre stablemates of the time.

That’s not to say the MMORPG is dead. A brand new one, Aion 2 , launched just this week and quickly found itself on Steam’s Most Played list. The long-awaited Guild Wars 3 is on the horizon. And many of the genre’s pioneering games continue to run successfully, some even 25 years on from their inception. But that’s become the genre’s norm – ongoing projects built on ageing technology, rather than fresh new blood. The “live-service” game has taken its place, but that controversial industry trend has stolen the crown that the MMORPG forged.

The Past, Present, and Future of Live-Service Live-service is one of the biggest issues in gaming. Is it a curse destined to destroy studios, or the key to the industry's survival? With expert insight from veteran developers, including Overwatch's Jeff Kaplan and Anthem's Mark Darrah, IGN exlores the long timeline of live-service games across three detailed articles. Combining interviews, analysis, and opinion, this is the past, present, and future of gaming's most divisive trend.

Massively multiplayer online role-playing games were the first live-service games, long before the term had become common parlance. Both formats share a similar definition: at their core, they are online multiplayer games that are continually expanded, evolved, and developed beyond their initial launch, with that process often buffered by microtransactions or subscription models. The one key difference is that the modern live-service game can be anything from a tight 6v6 battle arena to a galaxy-spanning looter shooter. MMORPGs, meanwhile, typically take place in large fantasy or sci-fi open worlds, inspired by (or sometimes set in) the likes of Dungeons & Dragons or Star Wars, allowing players to act out long-imagined fantasies together.

Their replication of a world, with cities to visit and countries to travel across, means there’s an innate communal core to MMORPGs – like in reality, the game’s digital population becomes a community. It’s a notably different feeling compared to the communities of many modern live-service titles, like Apex Legends and Overwatch , which often focus on short, trigger-happy play cycles. People don’t admire Fortnite’s often rebranded islands in the same way they do World of Warcraft’s Nagrand or Stormwind. One is a battlefield, the other is home.

MMORPGs evolved from multi-user dungeons, or “MUDS”. Back in the early days of the internet, MUDs functioned like a virtual chatroom hinged around a fantastical adventure. They were D&D for your desktop instead of your tabletop. As entertaining as they were, multiplayer gaming took a huge step toward how we understand it today in 1997 when Ultima Online launched. It is the game from which the term ‘MMORPG’ came from, coined by Richard Garriott, creator of the Ultima series. Directed by Starr Long, it was an ambitious spin-off from the mainline Ultima RPG series that gave players something brand-new: a world that could change whilst they weren’t playing.

“The idea you could play in a virtual world with thousands of other people was a pretty novel idea at the time”, Long tells me. “It was like, ‘Wow, I can play D&D with my friends without even needing to be in the same town.’”

Ultima Online was one of the earliest pioneers of many aspects that are now baked into almost every live-service game, including monthly subscriptions and digital currency purchasable through brick-and-mortar retail stores. It became the first MMORPG to reach 100,000 subscribers and it did so within six months – an unexpected success which led to severe performance issues. Players responded by staging a digital protest in the castle grounds of Garriott’s in-game alter-ego, Lord British, over-indulging on consumables in order to fill the area with vomit.
“That was the turning point where we realized, while we are the game creators, this is the players’ world,” says Long. “We’re just facilitating it for them.”

The success of Ultima Online was analysed by many, including EverQuest co-creator Bill Trost. “The whole Ultima series was a big influence on me throughout high school,” he recalls. And in 1999, just two years after Ultima Online, Trost, alongside co-creators Steve Clover and Brad McQuaid, launched EverQuest. Its 3D game engine demonstrated just what an MMORPG world could be, and led to EverQuest’s immense popularity.

While EverQuest’s world looked significantly more advanced, Ultima Online’s success had taught Trost that the most important thing was the communal experience. “My world-building philosophy was to build a world with integrity, but don’t design it to death,” he explains. “The world we built and situations we set up made people bond together.”

Trost attributes EverQuest’s ongoing success to the team’s light touch, allowing players to make sense of the game themselves. It’s a sentiment echoed by Long: “We realized that running one of these games is more like running a government. Your people are your citizens,” he says.

These expansive communities changed people’s lives. It was in EverQuest where Jeff Kaplan first met Blizzard’s Vice President of Game Design, Rob Pardo, via the Legacy of Steel guild. That fateful meeting led to Kaplan joining the World of Warcraft team as a quest designer, a position from which he eventually rose to become game director.

Kaplan loved EverQuest, clocking up over 6,000 hours of play, but always felt like there could be more to the game. Joining the World of Warcraft team was his opportunity to make that “more” a reality. Blizzard needed something special because the competition was tough – it not only had to battle Ultima Online and EverQuest’s existing success, but stand up against the hype for EverQuest 2 and Star Wars: Galaxies, both of which were on the horizon when World of Warcraft launched in 2004.

“Everyone said, ‘Who is this RTS company? Who do they think they are to make an MMO?,” Kaplan recalls. At the time, Blizzard was known solely as a strategy games developer, although its Diablo ARPG series, beloved for its online multiplayer, was perhaps the first sign that the studio would go on to make arguably the definitive MMORPG.

While Kaplan and his colleague, Pat Nagle, initially designed World of Warcraft’s quest system to match EverQuest, player test feedback told them one thing: the game needed way more quests. Of the many ways WoW revolutionized the modern MMORPG, creating a seemingly never-ending quest chain that propelled players through the world’s regions is perhaps the most important, setting the mold for quest systems moving forward. There are over 10,000 unique quests, and even the most hardcore players still find themselves challenged with new daily and weekly activities delivered by patches and expansions.

items.title: “已经有足够多的比赛被取消和关闭了。背叛会产生影响”——这是直播游戏终结的开始吗？
items.summary: Live-service dominates global playtime, but can it survive cancelled projects, dwindling players, and a market

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/05/the-future-of-live-service-games-blogroll-1791212010426.jpg

Not too long ago, it felt like there was no escape from live-service games. Bethesda’s unveiling of Fallout 76 in 2018 felt like an ominous bellwether – was every iconic franchise now fated to transform into a forever game? Was ever-evolving multiplayer with seasonal content updates the way forward for our favourite RPGs and shooters?

Fast forward eight years and the landscape is looking very different. Major gaming publishers are cancelling live-service games left, right and centre, while many newcomers arrive on the scene only to pack up their bags and disappear within a few short months.

Some will, understandably, celebrate the apparent downturn of the live-service model. Others, meanwhile, will see this as cause for concern. The battle pass era has been a veritable financial feast for the video games industry’s revenue growth – if it disappears, does that profitable growth disappear along with it? For some, the problem is not the disappearance of “forever games”, but the reasons why the sector is contracting. And another group will even challenge the assertion that live-service is even disappearing at all.
Above all else, one thing is clear: there’s change on the horizon.

The Past, Present, and Future of Live-Service Live-service is one of the biggest issues in gaming. Is it a curse destined to destroy studios, or the key to the industry's survival? With expert insight from veteran developers, including Overwatch's Jeff Kaplan and Anthem's Mark Darrah, IGN exlores the long timeline of live-service games across three detailed articles. Combining interviews, analysis, and opinion, this is the past, present, and future of gaming's most divisive trend.

By the end of January this year, 15 of the 19 major new live-service games launched in 2025 had lost over 80% of their initial playerbase . Among them were big, recognisable, popular names, including Persona 5: The Phantom X, Runescape: Dragonwilds and Dune: Awakening. Leveraging known, beloved IP is no longer a surefire ticket to success, something Sega learned this year following weak performance of its free-to-play push, including the likes of mobile battle royale Sonic Rumble Party. This significant stall lead to Sega cancelling its mysterious 'Super Game'.

PlayStation has found itself in a similar situation. According to a recent Bloomberg report , the company has either halted or outright cancelled the development of over a dozen live-service games over the last decade. Many of these were linked to marquee IP like Spider-Man and God of War. Most recently, the controversial Horizon Hunters Gathering has been rebooted , with the aim of essentially ‘unmaking’ the live-service aspects and turning it into a traditional co-op game. This determination to make live-service work for Horizon means a new entry in the series’ core single-player series is reportedly still years away from release . It’s a similar story for gaming stalwart Naughty Dog, whose years spent on the ill-fated The Last of Us Online meant progress on its next major cinematic narrative game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, was slowed. TLOU Online was ultimately cancelled to prevent Naughty Dog transforming into a live-service studio, and the majority of that game’s developers moved over onto Intergalactic to allow for full-scale production .

It’s not just live-service newcomers that’re suffering, though; even the heavyweights are beginning to feel the squeeze. Newzoo’s latest gaming report showed a 27% decline in the battle royale sub-genre, with live-service heavyweights Fortnite and Apex Legends both suffering a drop in playtime growth of almost a quarter. Despite Marvel Rivals’ immense success, many of the top shooters also saw a drop-off of at least 15%, including Overwatch, Call of Duty, and Valorant. An even broader overview of the market reveals that the free-to-play model itself is in decline, with playtime on PC down 8%, PlayStation down 4% and Xbox down 11% in 2025 compared to 2024. It’s a small drop, but if it’s the start of a larger trend, the live-service model may be beginning to flatline.

So why the downturn? Ex-BioWare executive producer Mark Darrah, who helped guide the ill-fated Anthem to the finish line, thinks people may be finally realizing the gold rush is over. “I think there’s a glimmer of understanding that if you're making a looter shooter and it’ll be a ‘decent’ looter shooter, that’s not enough anymore,” he says.

The original director of MMORPG pioneer Ultima Online, Starr Long, notes that it’s difficult to hook players into the classic live-service play cycle if they don’t trust that the game will even be online next month. “Enough games have been cancelled and shut down, so at this point people have a trust issue,” he says. “Players are asking ‘Why should I commit myself?’ That betrayal has long-term ramifications.”

For publishers, part of the allure of live-service games are the measurable metrics. Darrah notes that publishers can predict a player’s individual financial input into live-service games based on many minute actions. What someone did on their first day can inform the company of that person’s playstyle and, consequently, how much money they may be willing to part with. But if people are logging off your game and not coming back – or not even picking it up in the first place – that number is a big, fat zero.

But the explanation may be far simpler: perhaps the live-service cycle is simply just ending. That’s how Kat Osman, team director at British video games communication agency Lick PR, sees it: “There was a time when it felt like the focus was entirely on FPS games, a time when dance and music-based games were popular – we’ve all got those dusty peripherals hidden away in cupboards.” She doesn’t believe the live-service model will ever fade away – Just Dance still releases a new game year-on-year, after all – but thinks the format’s shiny allure has finally faded.

But what is the next cycle, if not more live-service? The answer may be the indie game marketplace, which has exploded in such a way that it makes the previous indie boom look quaint. R.E.P.O., Peak and Schedule I sold over 40 million copies in 2025. This year’s mega-hit Meccha Chameleon has sold 20 million copies since June 2026 and is close to cracking the 50 best-selling games of all time.
“I think the space between triple-As and indies is actually smaller than it used to be,” says Osman. “The success of these heavy hitting indies means developers don’t always need a publisher now.”

The indie game industry accounted for $4.5 billion last year, and 25% of Steam’s $17.7 billion revenue . It’s only expected to expand; games analytics agency Mordor Intelligence predicts the market will grow to $10.8 billion by 2031 . However, this is only part of the picture; How To Market A Game’s 2025 study showed that of 20,282 games released, only 608 achieved a significant success benchmark. That’s just 2.99%. And, like triple-A studios, indie development teams have been subject to significant restructuring due to the wider state of the industry, with a third of indie developers reporting layoffs in the 2026 GDC State of Gaming report.

items.title: I'm intrigued by this political sim that puts you smack-dab in Germany at the end of World War 1
items.summary: When everything was going incredibly fine.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HiHLFjPpVhDHvYcF3MTGKm.jpg
What if a board game was a visual novel and that visual novel knew what the Zimmerwald Conference was?

This was, I assume, written on the whiteboard at Red Echoes' conception. It's a well-balanced mix. In the demo, you take in the story through the eyes of three characters who each have their own special abilities—increasing revolutionary fervour wherever they're based, or putting a cap on reactionary zealotry, or decreasing the pressure experienced by other characters—and your task on a gameplay level is moving them around the board to where those abilities will be most useful when the turn ends.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DSaFDrBC5oQExV8Gs7EJgm.jpg
Balancing morality with pragmatism

Choices you make in the visual novel sections will impact the state of the game board: a decrease in fervour here, an increase in pressure there. Naturally, as a rashid proletarian you'll be inclined to make all the choices that lead Germany into a glorious red dawn, but playing a long game may mean making choices that go against your conscience and even permit the development of reaction in some quarters—short-term sacrifices for, you hope, long-term gains.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ruJ9wJnhDXmKFR99BSs7cm.jpg
You aren't the Big Communist Cheeses

It would have been easy, I think, to make a version of this game that simply put you in the shoes of Spartacist leaders Rosa Luxemburg and Karl Liebknecht. At least for the duration of the demo, that's not the case. You're in the shoes of Germany's hoi polloi: a dockworker, a radically inclined journalist, a mother whose sons are off dying in the Kaiser's war. It's an antidote to Great Man history and a perspective you rarely get in media: war-weary Germans toward the end of WW1.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qyNNzZfkECWAHTwaV8s3cm.jpg
It's perhaps a tad easy-going

At least in the early game, which is what the demo covers, it's not too difficult to play your cards right. With a little bit of forethought about how best to utilise my characters' abilities it was pretty easy to put the kibosh on the swelling reaction in most quarters of Berlin while, simultaneously, sending red sympathies sky-high in others.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/w4whkJaopaVbRLSBupbtbm.jpg
Rather lovely design

Red Echoes is a relatively simple game in terms of its layout, but it's still pretty striking. The map is done in the style of Weimar-era graphic design (it reminds me a little of constructivism , but then most things do), and it gradually fills in with pools of red for the revolution, or yellow for reaction, as the turns slip by and Germany's contradictions sharpen.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8bZss5BWFqR7MXVfAWD8cm.jpg
Solid writing

Being so much a visual novel, Red Echoes feels like a game that lives or dies by the strength of its writing. Even a few typos could be fatal to the thing it's trying to construct. Fortunately, it's been strong in this arena from what I've seen so far, with believable dialogue and characters that don't feel like they're just there to exposit at you about what Germany was like in 1918/19.

So, yes, Red Echoes is a rather intriguing little sim with a unique focus, and it promises to only eat up three or four hours of your time when the entire thing releases early next year. I will be keeping an eye on it. Rosa, Karl, and the revolution met with an unpleasant end in real life, but I reckon I can turn it around if you give me a shot.

items.title: Minecraft 主题公园是 Xbox 的“众多主题公园中的第一个”，但不要太兴奋
items.summary: Xbox has formalized its plans to extend its video games to places like film and TV via a new division called X

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/toem2-review-blogroll-1791396763264.jpg

When a troll blocking a bridge wants a photo of three goats, you get him a photo of three goats. Not only must you find goats to photograph, but you must perfectly position these goats – on three different ledges – to get all three in the photograph. TOEM 2 is full of these sorts of environmental puzzles that cleverly use a photo mode mechanic through the lens of your own in-game camera to define its gameplay. It is a hidden object game insomuch as you're searching for hidden objects, but it's no June's Journey, where you're searching through static images to pick out items. TOEM 2's world, like the original, is dynamic, surprising, and an absolute delight.

As the title would suggest, TOEM 2 is the follow-up to TOEM: A Photo Adventure from developer Something We Made, which was released in 2021. TOEM 2 is exceptionally similar to TOEM; the foundation remains exactly the same. You control a young lad who heads out from their quaint home to see an awe-inspiring seasonal event called the toem. Playing as that little guy, you travel from your home through three distinct towns in monochrome isometry. Bus tickets are necessary to keep moving from town to town, and those are earned through helping townsfolk. And to help these townsfolk is to take photos.
What we said about TOEM (2021)

TOEM is a short, satisfying little photography adventure packed with witty writing, goofy yet grounded characters, and a wealth of interesting, picturesque moments to capture. Though simple to complete, its diorama-like maps, cartoon style, and pleasing music and sounds make it an inviting world to stay in long enough to uncover all its secrets. Unpretentious and clever, TOEM encourages its audience to elevate the most seemingly mundane encounters through the scrupulosity of a camera lens, splashing its world with enough myth, humor, and joy to turn every moment into a photographable phenomenon as intriguing as the one in its title. - Rebekah Valentine, September 13, 2021
Score: 8
Read the full TOEM review .

You'll take photos of all sorts of things: Hidden garden gnomes, stinky cheese, and cute little critters. Each town in TOEM 2 is a series of connected, isometric dioramas rendered in a soft, 3D style and only in shades of black and white. The townsfolk retain the flatter, more hand-drawn aesthetic from the first game, letting them stand out among the environment. Creatures skitter about, clouds linger in the sky. Along the way, an invisible man on one forest block of the town may need a potion to become visible again (he’s only visible through the camera lens). A potion maker resides several blocks away; once you stumble upon him, he’ll ask for toadstools, send you out once again. Only then you’ll be able to make your way back to the invisible man and hand over the potion. Most of TOEM 2’s objectives typically play out like this and work as a way to encourage further exploration of the world. A lot of the time, you’ll find something surprising, or silly – a cat hiding in a flower pot, perhaps – and snap a photo. It’s so curious that it probably means something, but you’ve just not figured that out yet.

Beyond taking photos, each of these towns has a little gimmick tied to the camera. In the quaint farmland town Cropten, vines are spreading, blocking entrances and pathways. One of the first townspeople you’ll meet will attach a pair of scissors to your camera. That first townsperson, in Cropten, is a little worm who's very concerned about the vines. Instead of point-and-shoot, it’s also now point-and-snip. Vines pop up every now and then, the little worm would panic, and I'd gladly take care of it for them. The two other towns, Taletorp and Deltburg, have their own respective tools and enjoyable little, ongoing storyline around using them. And you can't miss the charming townsfolk you're introduced to immediately at the start of each level; they serve to tutorialize your new tools, and become a friend to wander about with.

TOEM 2 is about four or five hours long, so its simple premise never feels like a chore. Each of the worlds are so individually delightful that I didn't want to rush through any one location. It's one of the very rare games in which I was eager to seek out everything there was to discover. There are many more puzzles to solve than there are bus tickets required to progress, and once you've collected those bus tickets, the only incentive for continuing is the sheer joy of seeking what happens. There is a scarecrow, for instance, that wants to see the world and you can snap him in-and-out of different locations: at much too high heights, near a cozy fireplace, or back with some pesky birds. It's the three hidden gnomes that I've got in the back of my mind throughout it, checking nooks and crannies to see if I can spot them. Joy, throughout TOEM 2, is hopping off objects and onto rooftops, navigating curving platforms to reach the farthest peaks just to gain a new perspective on the world.

Oddly, TOEM 2's biggest limitation is that the original TOEM is fantastic. Using a camera to engage with the world through a neat photo mode in its particular way felt exceptionally novel; TOEM 2's camera upgrades and tools don't necessarily elevate it beyond that level of uniqueness. TOEM's art is hand-drawn, in a way that feels more intimate and raw; While TOEM 2 ' s characters retain that style, the world and its items are computer-modeled. It's still lovely and well-crafted, but it doesn't feel like an improvement or expansion on the first game.

Most prominently, though, TOEM's puzzles were a bit more engaging. TOEM 2 is very gentle, and effortlessly guides you through its photographic treasure hunt. It was breezy to play, and although that's not necessarily a bad thing, the touch of friction in the first game encouraged a deeper degree of curiosity. For instance, TOEM 2 has a quality-of-life sort of update to its camera – being able to lock the camera onto an object makes it much easier to capture photos of fast-moving objects, like a paper plane gliding in the air. It's a seemingly insignificant change that removes that stroke of friction that I wish TOEM 2 had. It wasn't exactly difficult to take photos without the focus lock, but it meant putting in some work for your perfect picture.

When answering the question of 'What does this all lead to?,' the end of TOEM 2 may seem disappointing. The toem phenomenon that the game is centered around isn't all too different from that of the first game. But TOEM 2 isn't disappointing on the whole, because it was never at all about reaching the end. Forgive me, but it really is what you've seen and discovered along the way.

items.title: 葱哥泄露《GTA6》长视频引争议 玩家怒斥剧透太缺德
items.summary: 今日，《GTA 6》泄露者“Cyberleek”（大葱哥）再次现身，并发布了一段长达24分钟的游戏实机视频，引发玩家对剧情剧透的担忧，许多…

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA 6》泄露者一边声称为玩家权益发声，一边却继续泄露剧情甚至借机牟利，你觉得这是在维护玩家权益，还是已经变成了消费玩家的骗局？
今日，《GTA 6》泄露者“Cyberleek”（大葱哥）再次现身，并发布了一段长达24分钟的游戏实机视频，引发玩家对剧情剧透的担忧，许多玩家纷纷在网络上提醒其他人注意避雷。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082200407980.png
今年8月，在多起高调的《GTA 6》泄露事件发生后，Cyberleek一度销声匿迹。Rockstar母公司Take-Two随后展开调查，并向包括Discord在内的平台发出了传票。如今Cyberleek再次发布泄露内容，也意味着其目前似乎仍未被找到。

Cyberleek此前声称，自己之所以泄露相关内容，是为了强调实体游戏媒介正在衰落，以及这一趋势可能对游戏所有权产生的影响。不过与此同时，该账号还通过加密货币让玩家付费投票，决定是否继续发布更多泄露内容，因此这一行为也被广泛认为带有明显的牟利性质。Cyberleek还曾因利用《GTA 6》泄露内容推广自己的虚拟货币而遭到大量批评。8月底对相关加密货币交易记录的分析显示，这名《GTA 6》泄露者疑似已经“套现”，并从中获利约27万美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082200512918.png
此次发布的新实机视频结尾，同样出现了一段疑似暗示其需要更多资金开展某个神秘项目的信息，不过具体内容较为晦涩。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082200594424.png
在他泄露新视频后，有玩家对此表示不满并喊话道：“当你最开始泄露《GTA 6》视频时，你说这么做是因为Rockstar不尊重玩家，以及实体游戏和光盘相关的问题。但现在，你却开始泄露这款所有人等待多年的游戏剧情。我们知道你根本不在乎玩家的权益。你只是一个想从玩家身上骗钱的骗子。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082201022853.png

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082202427072.png
据CBS News的专题报道，媒体将《GTA6》的罪恶城（Vice City）与现实原型迈阿密做实地对照，对本作开放世界的细节还原度给出高度评价。
报道走访迈阿密港、南海滩、温伍德、大沼泽地等代表性区域，发现游戏内已有超过100处地点能够找到现实原型，其中就包含NBA迈阿密热火队主场。热火队还会在后续比赛换上罪城主题球衣，以此迎接游戏11月发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082202523875.png
不少细节充满巧思：现实 Breakwater 酒店在游戏中化名为 Boardwalk 酒店；Dixon 酒店名字致敬该片区经典建筑的设计师 L. Murray Dixon，属于专门留给本地居民的彩蛋。报道同时提到，R 星不只是复刻建筑外观，也试图还原迈阿密的文化气质，将复古装饰艺术建筑与现代摩天大楼融为一体。
为了打磨这份真实感，R星团队曾深度扎根佛罗里达当地，接触帮派成员、前警察，走访各色区域，吸收从富人区到贫民街区的社会百态。游戏虚构的雷奥奈达州一共划分六大区域，包含丰富的海陆游玩内容。

content.v: AliceSoft传奇名作《兰斯7：战国兰斯》于10月2日登陆了PC Steam发售，支持简体中文，首发特惠55.2元，目前游戏在Steam上获得玩家“好评如潮”评价。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261008/1791467296_241769_jpg_r.jpg
主要剧情
刚结束了广袤大陆上的精彩冒险，无畏的剑士兰斯如今又来到了东方岛国日本。
兰斯希望能在他忠诚的法师仆从希露的陪伴下，尽享日本的温泉……而且他坚称织田家的香姬是自己的“养成对象”。
一路征伐，兰斯不知道怎么回事就成了一国之主，但是他并不会止步于此。不论是战场还是情场，兰斯都打算走得更远，直到得到自己渴望的一切，而现在我们的大英雄兰斯最想要的就是……力量！就这样，兰斯踏上了统一日本，征服全国的征程！
游戏性
以战略玩法结合角色扮演，管理自己的领土，军队，资源和英雄，同时为兰斯不断开辟征程，征服日本。玩家的选择将改变群雄割据的格局，决定战争局势的走向和各地大名贵族的兴衰。控制手下的领土，加强守备，抉择如何发展，平衡每个地区的进攻防守和发展投入。当战斗开始时，玩家指派的指挥官会在回合制战斗中与敌军开展，灵活利用每个角色的能力有时能逆风翻盘。
游戏特色
领地和资源的管理
在这个战略角色扮演游戏中，不断征服邻近地区扩大自己的领土，扩张自己的势力范围，充分利用好新领土提供的资源以及各个地区的战略价值。
角色招募
随着领地扩张，数十名拥有自己故事和专属能力的著名英雄将加入兰斯的征服大业。如何组建拥有合适能力和技能的队伍来应对不同的挑战，是否能成功的关键。
遭遇战和迷宫
派遣部队和指挥官，与他们并肩作战，做好面对各种敌人的准备。每次战斗前都要注意调整自己的队伍到最佳状态。毕竟，敌人也都是著名的英雄，也会有自己的特殊能力和各种不同类型的军队。
玩家还可以派遣部队深入迷宫，搜刮宝物和各种资源
事件和故事分支选择
在不断地征战期间，如何管理军队，征服哪些区域，推进了多远都可能影响剧情的展开。游玩中的操作和事件中的选择将改变故事走向，开辟出不同的分支，以招募不同的特殊角色并解锁他们的专属秘密事件。
多周目要素值得反复游玩
除了一周目的正史路线外，还有更多角色的专属剧情发展等着玩家解锁，将故事带向新的方向。多周目游戏可选择继承之前的游戏内容。新的周目会因为玩家的选择和游玩方式而走向不同的分支。

items.title: No, I Have Not Seen Jason’s Penis in GTA 6
items.summary: IGN cannot confirm or deny if GTA 6 will feature full-frontal nudity, but we can confirm that we have not seen

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/gta6-jason-nude-1791466710599.webp

There are many things we at IGN expected people to take away from our big interview with Rockstar North about Grand Theft Auto 6 . The fact that I may or may not have seen protagonist Jason Duval’s penis was not particularly high on that list.
And yet, here we are.

In my coverage, I mentioned a scene in which Jason is naked in the shower. This has apparently led some corners of the internet to conclude that I was treated to a full-frontal reveal of one of GTA 6’s leading men. For the sake of journalistic accuracy, I feel compelled to clarify: I did not see Jason’s penis.

Yes, Jason was naked. Yes, he was in the shower. But thanks to some carefully positioned camera angles, his modesty remained entirely intact. Whatever Rockstar has or hasn’t rendered beneath the belt remains a mystery to me, just as it does to you. Yes, that naughty leaker has been at it again , but we can't be sure when that footage was taken, which "assets" are just for the developer builds, and what will make it into the final game.

I appreciate that this may be disappointing news to those hoping for an exclusive report on the state of Jason’s anatomy, but I can only write about what I’ve actually seen. And trust me, if I had seen it, you would have gotten more than a single sentence.

Of course, if Jason does indeed have a fully-rendered penis, he won't be the first GTA character to have one. Grand Theft Auto 5 offered a semi-obscured look at Trevor's crown jewels during a custcene. Meanwhile, players who explored the mountains surrounding Los Santos will have come across the Altruist Cult, which features several fully-nude members (ahem) among its number.

The fact that nudity will be in the game had previously been confirmed by the leaked European PEGI rating for GTA 6 . "There are also strong sexual themes, including nudity, scenes of intercourse and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes," it revealed. "In various night clubs the player can also pay for private dances, during which, the game allows the player to move their hands onto the dancers’ breasts and buttocks." It stopped short of confirming full-frontal nudity, though.

IGN remains committed to bringing you the most important GTA 6 news as it happens. Apparently, this now includes genital visibility. For today's non-nude headlines, check out CBS News' astonished report about how accurately GTA 6 recreates Miami , and the Australian government's advice on how to take time off to play GTA 6 .

items.title: Spiritfarer dev's next game, At Fate's End, is one of the prettiest things I've ever seen
items.summary: Simply gorgeous.

content.v: A lot of games look good, with all of those high-end newfangled graphics and shaders and what-not. And don't get me wrong, I love a texture or a shader as much as the next PC gamer. But it's rare that a game stuns me with something simple. At Fate's End, even during its demo , has achieved just that.

Developed by Spiritfarer creators Thunder Lotus, At Fate's End is a sort of hybrid between a visual novel and an action adventure game. There's a clear delineation between combat and exploration—in the former, you're having conversations and exploring, in the latter, the game plays a little more like Silksong.

At Fate's End follows protagonist Shan Hemlock who, for reasons unknown, has been named the Princess of Swords. It's her duty, along with her god sword Aesus, to gather all the blades of her (likely messed-up family), through force or diplomacy. Here's my first impressions:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sWPSAaDCypdPHWNPubFHii.jpg
Frame a painting

At Fate's End is adoringly animated—it's rare that I'll play a 2D game like this where there's almost no effort spared. The fact that I had to stop for a moment to stare at just how pretty Shan's 'I've stopped running' animation was—carrying her momentum with a cinematic gust of her hair—is a sign of things to come.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HyQ6muGoneEWM5C8HpA7aF.jpg
A pretty picture

It's not just how it moves, though, it's how it looks. At Fate's End has this hand-drawn storybook styling that pairs with its eye-meltingly pretty tarot cards and stylised menus so deliciously that I want to find a way to scrunch it up and eat it. Even the sodding overworld screen is wallpaper-worthy.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/C4mSfyQGsWkwX6kMjH9g4N.jpg
Heart of the cards

It helps that I'm intrigued by the game's mechanics, too. At Fate's End has an equip-able card system where you're inspired by clashes with your siblings to take on some of their abilities. However, each of these cards, like a tarot, has a reverse. For instance, big sister Camilla can let you either dash across the field or double-jump.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aMrN63efwep8xpam7s5VbU.jpg
A few directions

Combat itself is a little rudimentary at first, though has plenty of room for depth. Like most 2D action games, it's based on positioning. You have an omnidirectional attack and the aforementioned abilities, which you can activate once you've built up enough Arcana energy. There's a pleasantly-themed skill tree to help out, too.

items.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered Patch Adds Bloom Toggles on Console and Larger Lighting Changes
items.summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered just got a significant update to tweak the presentation of CD Projekt’s

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/25/witcher3-firstminsoo-1790354351574.png
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered just got a significant patch to tweak the presentation of CD Projekt’s RPG epic.

Despite the remaster offering a host of improvements over the base game — visually and mechanically — not everyone was happy with how it turned out. Some fans across Reddit and social media complained about its heavy bloom effects, which created a washed out look and removed many of the original game’s stark shadows. Tonally, it felt meaningfully different, and the overdone bloom made it difficult to appreciate other graphical improvements.

“I started the training part at the beginning of the game [and] I noticed that the blooming effects are jacked all the way up which causes the image to look washed out and makes everything look too bright in the environment,” one Reddit poster said. “At first I assumed that it was either the game or my TV settings but after messing with the settings for like an hour I realized that it's actually the game having a ridiculous blooming effect. The PC version allows people to shut the blooming off but the console version doesn't have a way to turn off the blooming.”

The latest patch addresses that issue, allowing console players to toggle bloom off, along with light shafts, and depth of field. Elsewhere, the developer has made improvements to bloom, tone mapping, character lighting, and fancy ray tracing and path tracing tech.

“In addition to this, we are also working on an update for the Nintendo Switch 2 version of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered, introducing closer parity between all versions of the game, including the same global changes as on other platforms,” CD Projekt said in the blog post. “It will also improve on some Nintendo Switch 2-specific aspects, such as image clarity and sharpness. Expect more information regarding this in the following days.”

Prior to the latest patch, fans were creating Steam Forum threads urging other players to switch bloom off entirely. In one comparison shot , you can see how bloom impacted the overall image before the improvements.

Patch 5.01 is roughly 5.5 GB on console and 8.5 GB on PC. There’s no word yet on whether The Witcher 3’s remaster will make use of QSSR, Sony’s new upscaling method for base PS5 . CD Projekt has typically been at the forefront of tech advances, with its previous game, Cyberpunk 2077 , still an absolute showcase of what a good gaming PC can do.

CD Projekt’s next major game will be The Witcher 4 , part continuation part reboot, where you play as Geralt’s adopted daughter, Ciri, as she learns to carry the burden of a Witcher. It’s still a while off, however, with The Witcher 4 planned for a 2028 release .

Before that, in 2027, we’ll get a brand new expansion for The Witcher 3, called Songs of the Past . The new expansion will be as big and ambitious as Blood & Wine, working as a gap filler between the events of The Witcher 3 and its sequel.

To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the Things The Witcher 3 Doesn’t Tell You , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 Walkthrough and The Witcher 3 Endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 Sex and Romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher Gear Locations , Places of Power Locations , and even Gwent Card Locations .

content.v: 本站将坚守立场，不会发布任何涉及本次泄露的剧情、画面等直接剧透内容。
据IGN报道，此前引发轩然大波的《GTA6》泄密者Cyberleek再度现身，于网络上传了一段时长24分钟的非授权游戏实机视频，海量剧情内容外泄，在玩家社群引发严重的剧透隐患。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082119469729.png
早在今年8月Cyberleek就放出过一批本作的泄露内容，R星母公司Take‑Two随即展开法律调查，向Discord等平台递交传票调取信息，此后该泄密账号一度沉寂。而本次新泄露证明，无论Cyberleek是个人还是团体，依旧逍遥在外，外界至今无法搞清这批游戏素材究竟是如何突破R星严密安保流出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082119543765.png
Cyberleek此前对外宣称，泄露素材是为抗议实体介质消亡对游戏所有权带来的影响，但同时利用加密货币让粉丝付费投票决定后续泄露内容，被不少玩家视作借机牟利。

本站的立场十分明确：我们不会转载、放出本次泄露的任何实机画面，也不会复述、拆解序章的剧情细节，不做任何形式的直接剧透内容，尽可能守护大家后续通关的游戏体验。

items.title: 《NBA 2K27》8 月超越《Madden NFL 27》，无人震惊
items.summary: Circana has posted its August 2026 monthly report, and unsurprisingly, NBA 2K27 is once again the best-selling

content.v: Circana has posted its August 2026 monthly report, and unsurprisingly, NBA 2K27 is once again the best-selling game for the month. That's hardly a shocker, as it was the best-selling August game in 2024 and 2025, ending a long winning streak previously held by EA's Madden NFL series of football games. While it didn't clinch the top spot, Madden NFL 27 came in second and fourth place, as the game's Kickoff Bundle version also appeared on the charts.

Overall, it was a solid month for new games. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls debuted in third place, Star Wars Zero Company landed in fifth place, and Big Walk took eighth place. In total, five of the top 10 best-selling games in August were new, with Halo: Campaign Evolved , the Switch 2 port of Elden Ring , Mario Kart World, and Splatoon Raiders rounding out the list. Here's a closer look at August's top 10 best-selling games in the US:
Top 10 Best-Selling Games In The US Ranked on Physical & Full Game Digital Dollar Sales

So how does this affect the list of best-selling games in the US so far in 2026? NBA 2K27 has made it onto those charts, but the current record-holder, Resident Evil Requiem, isn't budging yet. NBA 2K27 has instead usurped the third-place position held by Crimson Desert, while other games like 007 First Light and MLB The Show 26 have held onto their respective rankings.

There has been some slight movement between the top-selling games, but things remain largely the same for now. We expect that to change once the data for all games released during the bumper September and October months is analyzed, and of course, GTA 6 is expected to be a sales juggernaut when it arrives in November.

items.title: US Video Game Hardware Sales Just Had Their Worst August In 13 Years
items.summary: Video game console sales in the US hit their worst August in 13 years, as Circana's Mat Piscatella revealed th

content.v: Video game console sales in the US hit their worst August in 13 years, as Circana's Mat Piscatella revealed that hardware sales fell 15% from a year ago to 559,000 units. This is the lowest August total since 2013 (423,000 units), with PlayStation sales down 11% year-over-year, Xbox unit sales down 31% year-over-year (the lowest August total since 2020), and Nintendo unit sales down 15% compared with August 2025.

The silver lining (for the companies making these machines) is that higher hardware prices have pushed the average price from $476 in 2025 to $541 in 2026, meaning consumers are paying more for fewer machines on the market. Several factors are at play: current console prices are at historical highs, not lows, driven by global component pressure and mid-gen hardware upgrades like the $900 PS5 Pro, which pushes average prices up.

Basically, consumers are buying fewer units because the entry barrier is much higher than in past console cycles. After six years, market saturation has also likely set in for the Xbox Series X|S and PS5, and hardware price increases implemented earlier in 2026 triggered a massive buying wave to get ahead of the price hikes. That led to frontloaded demand and drained potential summer console purchases, but for Sony, dollar sales actually grew 17% year-on-year due to higher-tier hardware models, even as unit volume dropped 11%.

Historically, August 2013 can also be seen as the twilight phase of the PS3 and Xbox 360 era. It's a tale as old as time, as 13 years ago, gamers were saving their cash and preparing to invest in a PS4 or an Xbox One ahead of their November 2013 launch. We're not seeing that with this console generation, as no successor machines have been officially unveiled and hardware sales have slowed despite the mid-generation push.

When it came to games, NBA 2K27 was unsurprisingly the best-selling game of August, and it's the third-best-selling game of 2026 so far. Madden NFL 27 was the second-best-selling game of August, and thanks to a Switch 2 port , Elden Ring finished August as the seventh-best-selling game that month (and up from 41 in July). Piscatella noted that 2026 year-to-date spending on new physical software has also increased by 5% when compared to a year ago, up to $738 million. Spending on Switch 2 Game-Key Card physical releases has also risen 631% , which has offset a 3% drop in spending across all other new physical media types.

Traditional discs and full-data cartridges continue their steady multi-year decline as more players switch directly to digital storefronts, but because Game-Key Cards were a smaller segment of the physical market in 2025, major publishers' sudden adoption in 2026 drove that massive percentage jump. That added enough dollar volume to pull total physical software spending into positive territory (+5% overall to $738M), further obscuring the ongoing drop in traditional disc/cartridge media.

Total content spending also fell 10% year-over-year to $3.8 billion, bringing year-to-date content spending down 2% to $32.2 billion. Mobile saw the biggest drop, with spending down 18% year-over-year, while console spending fell 7% year-over-year. But PC gaming? It was an anomaly: spending on that platform grew 13% year-over-year, and subscription purchases also rose 3%.

content.v: 近日，向佐在综艺《大哥小助理》中谈及自己早年健身经历，自曝曾为了快速练出肌肉，长期大量饮用浓缩蛋白粉，而且每次都将蛋白粉冲得非常浓。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082046353412.png
向佐表示，长期如此导致自己的身体出现严重问题，肾功能一度衰退，节目中更形容当时的身体状态“像70岁的老人”，严重时甚至连走路都受到影响。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082046399765.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082046409907.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082046429860.png
回忆这段经历时，向佐也直言：“那个时候就是我喝太多蛋白粉了，蛋白粉喝太浓了。”他认为当时长期超量、高浓度饮用蛋白粉，是导致自己出现肾脏问题的重要原因之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082047035011.png
蛋白质的具体摄入需求会受到年龄、体重、运动量以及训练目标等多种因素影响，蛋白粉主要用于补充日常饮食中不足的蛋白质，并非摄入越多越好。对于有基础疾病或特殊健康状况的人群，具体摄入量仍应遵循专业人士建议。

content.v: Xbox 近日宣布成立全新娱乐部门XP，由曾任职于Mojang和卢卡斯影业的凯琳·沃尔特斯担任总裁。该部门将整合公司内部现有的影视、消费品、战略合作与线下活动业务，旨在扩大游戏IP影响力并吸引更多受众。
https://image.gcores.com/1ad27249363a3a8c4f6e49de9e43164b-1536-864.jpg
按照规划，XP业务主要分为四个板块。其中，Xbox影视负责电影和电视等线性叙事，Xbox产品专注于粉丝周边商品，XboxPlaces主打线下活动和沉浸式体验，Xbox合作伙伴关系则致力于对接外部创作者与品牌。
微软此前表示，公司的长远目标是成为全球第一大娱乐公司。随着新部门的成立，官方希望将经典游戏打造成跨越世代和全球的持久特许经营权。
沃尔特斯在行业内拥有丰富的特许经营权管理经验。她在卢卡斯影业供职13年，曾参与推动知名IP的发展与重启。在Mojang任职期间，她将《我的世界》销量从3.5亿份推高至4.25亿份，使其周边商品业务跻身全球前二十。由其推进的《我的世界》大电影曾创下视频改编电影的最佳首周末开画纪录，并夺得北美票房冠军，Mojang还借此完成了首个主题乐园项目的布局。

items.title: 超大尺度《猛鬼追魂》新作IGN6分 内容臃肿不够吓人
items.summary: 第一人称动作恐怖生存游戏《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》已于10月8日正式发售。媒体评分正式解禁，IGN打出6分。

content.v: 第一人称动作恐怖生存游戏《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》已于10月8日正式发售。媒体评分正式解禁，IGN打出6分。
据了解，作为以“欲望与痛苦”著称的系列，《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》毫不回避大尺度元素，反而将其放大到极致。开发商曾表示本作旨在“挑战所能展示的极限”。玩家将扮演主角艾丹，深入由地狱迷宫构成的异世界，利用神秘的解谜盒“悲怆之盒”的力量，从恐怖的境地中拯救女友桑妮。
IGN 6分 ：尚可
虽然经典反派钉子头（Pinhead）那布满钉子的头皮确实还原得相当到位，但遗憾的是，《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》其他方面却很难达到同样的水准。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082025347442.png
总评：
作为一个从小就被《猛鬼追魂》系列电影吓到的人，我在《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》中穿梭于那些被称为“家园”的庞大异世界迷宫、与地狱修道士正面对峙时，确实获得了一些刺激感。
游戏的战斗系统虽然缺乏新意，但整体表现尚可，足以带来令人满意的屠杀体验。一些尺度相当大胆的解谜环节也确实令人印象深刻，尽管它们并没有多大的挑战性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082025425852.jpg
然而，《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》在维持紧张感方面经常表现不佳。敌人遭遇战很容易被玩家牵着鼻子走；剧情过于依赖直接讲述，而不是通过实际演出展现；此外，重复出现的Boss战和追逐战也相当令人厌烦，让原本约9小时的流程显得有些臃肿。
虽然钉子头那布满钉子的头皮确实做得非常还原，但遗憾的是，除了这一点之外，《克莱夫·巴克的猛鬼追魂：复活》的其他部分都没有达到同样出色的程度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082025506981.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082025514070.jpg

AI短剧近年飞速普及，不仅改变影视行业生态，也走进了大众乃至艺人的日常生活。近日，女星小S（徐熙媛）在综艺中分享了自己的新奇追剧经历，自曝沉迷小众AI题材短剧，还为此高额氪金，引发网友热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082029564409.png
节目中，小S听完嘉宾的AI相关分享后，顺势聊起当下火热的AI创作趋势，并坦言自己近期深陷《爱上兽人》系列AI剧集。这番发言也被现场嘉宾调侃观影口味独特。据小S透露，她最初仅充值1000元会员追剧，看完第一季后续集数迟迟未更新，心急之下直接加码充值8889元，希望解锁全集内容。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261008/1791463107_897738.webp
The Coalition的CEO Mike Crump解释说，《战争机器：事变日》为系列的未来游戏打下了“良好的基础”，暗示该系列还会继续开发新作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261008/1791463063_891664.webp
在谈到续作时，在接受BBC采访时，Mike Crump解释说，有了坚实的基础，下一款《战争机器》游戏的开发周期就不会像《事变日》那样长。
作为参考，《战争机器：事变日》从2019年的《战争机器5》到发售花了大约7年时间，即使以3A游戏的标准来看，这也算是相当长的时间了。
有人担心，《事变日》在放弃PS5平台变成Xbox独占游戏后，可能难以收回超过4亿美元的预算。Mike表示，团队为《事变日》设定了财务目标和目标玩家数量，但他认为衡量成功需要更全面的考量。
他说：“我们这里有一支很棒的团队。特别是领导团队，他们已经合作超过20年了。所以，知识和经验的传承性绝对很强。”
此前，《战争机器：事变日》在片尾字幕中被发现ZZZQ公司而遭到玩家的强烈批评，游戏中充斥着DEI元素，而现在官方似乎给出了不一样的看法。

items.title: "薄肌理论"走红 搭配"喝大水大睡觉"成健康新潮流
items.summary: 近日，网络热词 #薄肌理论# 登上社交平台，它和“喝大水”“大睡觉”一同出圈，被网友称作当代年轻人追捧的极简健康三部曲。

content.v: 近日，网络热词 #薄肌理论# 登上社交平台，它和“喝大水”“大睡觉”一同出圈，被网友称作当代年轻人追捧的极简健康三部曲。这一概念爆火，背后不只是一场身材审美风潮，更折射出年轻人对自我状态的新思考。
薄肌理论属于网络衍生流行概念，并非专业运动科学名词。它所追求的是低体脂、线条干净，肌肉紧致但体量并不夸张的体态，通俗概括便是“穿衣显瘦，脱衣有肉”，偏好宽肩窄腰的倒三角身形，视觉上呈现出经过训练，却没有厚重肌肉带来的压迫感。该审美既区别于健美健身追求的大块肌肉形态，也不是节食减重造成的干瘪单薄。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082013098332.jpg
这套“薄肌+喝大水+大睡觉”的组合能够快速流行，藏着当代年轻人的心理诉求。
首先是低成本的自我掌控感。在充满不确定性的日常中，足量饮水、保证睡眠、适度训练，门槛不高，普通人容易上手，年轻人借此获得对自身身体的掌控权。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082013103381.jpg
其次是可感知的正向反馈。身材管理被不少年轻人看作为数不多“付出就能看见变化”的事，身材状态成为普通人能够把握的一份“确定资产”。同时，审美风向发生转变，清爽、少年感的风格受到喜爱，薄肌的审美标准普适性更强，相比传统高强度增肌，入门门槛更低。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082015243682.jpg
不过医生与健身爱好者也提醒，薄肌只是一种审美偏好，绝非统一的健康标准。每个人骨架、先天基因存在差异，不必强行对标同款身材。
看似没有高强度增肌那么辛苦，但想要塑造清晰紧致的薄肌线条，需要力量训练搭配饮食调控，做到降低体脂同时保留肌肉，实现起来并不简单。盲目追求极低体脂，会扰乱人体激素分泌，带来健康隐患。体脂过高或过低都存在健康风险，身材审美应当让位给身体健康本身。

items.title: Xbox Is Going Bigger On Movies, TV, And More With New XP Division
items.summary: Xbox has officially unveiled a new division dedicated to movies and TV, called XP. The new branch of Xbox will

others.title: Xbox Announces New XP Entertainment Division to Make Movies, TV, and More

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/xp-white-1791419443389.png

Xbox has announced a new TV, movies, and entertainment division called XP. It will be headed up by Kayleen Walters, a Lucasfilm veteran who moves over from her most recent post as president of Minecraft maker Mojang, where she also served as an executive producer on last year's A Minecraft Movie.

XP brings together four "areas of investment": Xbox Pictures; Xbox Products; Xbox Partnerships; and Xbox Places. Microsoft said XP was set up to help Xbox become the number one entertainment and gaming company in the world, which requires broadening its big franchises beyond video games themselves. But it is not a production company. Rather, Microsoft wants to find the right partners to work across film, TV, physical experiences, and consumer products.

Microsoft has already seen significant success in the movie and TV space, with Warner Bros.' A Minecraft Movie breaking box office records, and Amazon's Fallout TV show setting records for Prime Video. Upcoming Xbox adaptations include movie sequel Minecraft Squared, Fallout Season 3, a Call of Duty movie with Peter Berg and Taylor Sheridan, and a Diablo animated series with Netflix . Microsoft's deal for Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor Physint includes film and TV rights, so expect an adaptation of that eventually.

XP is also about live events, and again, Xbox already has success there. Blizzard's BlizzCon saw a number of significant announcements , with 35,000 people at the physical event in Anaheim, California, and 12.5 million watching at home. The most recent Minecraft Live , which saw the announcement of the first new dimension for Minecraft in 14 years, reached more than 144 million people.
Meanwhile, Microsoft cited partnerships such as Gears of War's takeover with WWE, and Xbox's range of Ikea furniture . A Minecraft theme park is set to open its gates next year .

"XP was created from a simple but powerful belief: the world's most beloved gaming franchises have an opportunity to reach people far beyond the boundaries of the game itself," Walters said. "Fans don't just play our franchises. They watch them, wear them, attend them, celebrate them, and connect with them in countless ways. XP brings together the teams responsible for helping Xbox franchises show up in the world in bigger, more meaningful ways."

"XP is a play on 'Experience Points' and formalizes four investment areas for us: Xbox Pictures for film and television adaptations; Xbox Products for licensing and merchandise; Xbox Partnerships for sponsors and brand partners; and Xbox Places for our marquee broadcast and in-person events, theme parks, and other location-based experiences," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma wrote in a company-wide memo also posted to Xbox Wire.

"Our franchises can mean more to people than the time they spend playing them, and Kayleen knows how to build those experiences with the industry without losing what made people care about the franchise in the first place."

Microsoft noted the uplift its video games can get when movies and shows do well. For example, Fallout games on Game Pass saw a 5x increase in hours played during Fallout Season 1. Minecraft, meanwhile, saw over a 75% increase in weekly active users year-over-year since the movie released (as of April 30, 2026).

If this sounds a bit familiar, it's because Microsoft has tried this before. In 2012 (back in the Xbox 360 era!), Microsoft announced Xbox Entertainment Studios with an aim to produce TV shows that would air directly on Xbox consoles. XES revealed plans to create shows based on Gears of War, Fable, Forza, and State of Decay — not to mention, of course, the original version of the Halo TV show announced at E3 by Stephen Spielberg , who was set to executive produce. They even planned to make an unscripted street-soccer drama called Every Street United. The entire XES effort lasted just two years before getting shut down as the Xbox One's "all in one" message failed to resonate with gamers following its reveal in 2013.

As part of the changes, Mojang has a new boss. Maria Angelidou-Smith, who joins Xbox as CEO of Mojang, spent nearly a decade at Meta working on Facebook Groups before stints at Personio and Reddit, where she was Chief Product Officer. "She has built products used by billions of people and led product and engineering organizations through significant growth and change," Sharma said.

"She will bring that experience to Mojang while learning from the people who know Minecraft best. Her first order of business is for her to learn from the teams and communities that make Minecraft so special."

Minecraft is, of course, one of the big Xbox franchises the company is doubling down on amid Sharma's ongoing "Reset," which has seen nearly 2,000 staff cut from the gaming business so far this financial year. Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time, having shifted over 425 million copies. Its significant merchandising business became one of the top 20 globally.

content.v: 据IGN报道，微软Xbox正式官宣成立全新娱乐部门XP（Experience Points），旨在跳出纯游戏研发框架，全方位拓展旗下知名游戏IP的影视、周边、线下活动等多元业态，冲击全球顶尖娱乐游戏厂商行列。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082012471436.png

全新XP部门由前Mojang总裁、参与制作《我的世界》大电影的资深行业人凯琳·沃尔特斯执掌，整体分为四大核心板块：负责影视动画改编的Xbox Pictures、主打周边授权的Xbox Products、统筹品牌合作的Xbox Partnerships，以及承办线下展会、主题场景的Xbox Places。不同于自研工作室，XP部门主打对外合作模式，联动优质行业资源孵化IP衍生内容，不独立负责内容制作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082012544240.png
事实上，Xbox早已在IP跨界领域收获颇丰。《我的世界》大电影票房大爆、亚马逊《辐射》剧集创下平台收视纪录，也反向带动游戏本体热度：剧集播出期间，《辐射》游戏游玩时长暴涨5倍，《我的世界》电影上线后，周活用户同比提升75%。
目前Xbox已有大批跨界内容蓄势待发，包括《我的世界》续作电影、《辐射》第三季、《使命召唤》真人电影、Netflix《暗黑破坏神》动画，以及小岛工作室新作的影视改编计划。同时暴雪、我的世界专场直播等线下线上活动热度居高不下，线下展会可容纳3.5万人，线上观看人次最高突破1.44亿，IP线下商业价值持续释放。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082013068077.png
值得一提的是，这并非微软首次布局娱乐赛道。早在Xbox360时代，微软就曾组建Xbox娱乐工作室，规划《光环》《战争机器》《极限竞速》等IP影视项目，但受限于当时Xbox One“全能娱乐主机”的错位定位，项目仅维持两年便宣告夭折。如今重启该战略，也是微软结合过往经验的全新升级尝试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/08/small_202610082013153493.jpg
伴随此次架构调整，Mojang工作室也迎来人事变动，拥有Meta、Reddit资深从业经验的玛丽亚·安杰利杜-史密斯出任新负责人。在Xbox本轮大规模业务精简、近2000人裁员的调整背景下，微软重点加码《我的世界》等顶流IP的跨界孵化，进一步凸显IP生态化的战略重心。
