items.title: We tried to earn as much gold in WoW: Forever as we could in 2 hours—which involved a mugging, slander, and at least one crashout
items.summary: Wisdom, charisma, and courage.

content.v: If you want to make money in World of Warcraft, well… I cannot rightly say that we at PC Gamer are any good at it, based on the evidence given to us—but we are at least inventing new ways of money-making. And isn't invention the mother of necessity? Or was it the other way around? Who cares, we've got pockets to line.

I wrangled two of my erstwhile co-workers, Fraser Brown and Joshua Wolens, to see which of us was the best at making money in World of Warcraft: Forever's beta. Which felt like a fair testing ground, given both how populated it is and how un-inflated its new, fledgling economy would be. Here were the rules:

Each of us entered with a different strategy. Well, two of us did (more on that later) to try and make the most bank. I, the Orc of Wisdom, would weaponise my 15+ years of roleplay experience to trade knowledge with the masses. Josh, the Majestic Celebrity, would try to wield his status as a games journalist and very famous person to his benefit—hamstrung only by the fact he had never actually played much World of Warcraft.
There was also Fraser, as Boeuf Beef, who did a secret third thing. I'll let him enlighten you about his masterful machinations myself.

This is a story of wisdom, courage, and bull-headed bravery—and, more importantly, it's a story of how those virtues could be mercilessly weaponised to siphon as much money from the economy as possible.
I've been roleplaying in MMOs for about 16 years—it is, in fact, what got me into writing—so rather than simply beg the masses for hand-outs, I would use it. I am, first and foremost, an entertainer.

I assembled a document full of snippets of wisdom—some reworded adages and sayings, others my original work—and decided to leverage them around WoW: Forever's new campfire feature. For those not in the know, anyone with a cooking skill can set down a campfire, around which may be set various fixtures. Sit around the fire for a minute, and you'll get buffs.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eBYMYYMsojYbhcxVu7dJoc-1920-80.png

This made for a pretty cheap initial investment of seven silver and 66 copper: Enough to train my cooking skill as well as some simple wood and tinder. All of which was available on the jog up to Razor Hill, which was very pretty. An auspicious sign, I thought, for my journey.

With the ability to make campfires in hand, I parked myself somewhere people would be forced to interact with me by game mechanics alone: The top of a zeppelin tower. Being the only convenient route to the Undercity, home to the new Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon everyone was keen to try, passengers would be forced to stand around while I gave them my spiel.

Originally, I was going to set a static price for my wisdom—but at the last minute, I decided to change my tact to simply requesting whatever people could spare. I am, after all, a humble old orc simply looking for a hot meal and a place to stay. Durotar nights get so very cold.

And, listen—I'm guilty of my fair share of cynicism of the MMO populace, but the two hours I spent up here were nothing short of delightful as the WoW community played ball. Here's a short-list of the characters I encountered:
I had a lovely old time—and one that was very profitable. My final score—minus my initial silver stipend—can be found at the bottom of this article.

I don't know what WoW is. I don't know what my abilities are. I don't know where this zeppelin is taking me and I don't know what the buttons in my hotbar do. I don't know what any of this shit is and I'm fucking scared .

What I do know: I'm incredibly important. My name is on something like 68 million articles on PC Gamer dot com, making me a rough hybrid of Scarlett Johansson and George Herbert Walker Bush in fame and significance. Play to your strengths, they always told me, so off I went to ignore circa 99% of WoW's actual mechanics in favour of simply impressing my incredible renown on other players and asking them for money.
My other strength is slander, so at the same time as I harangued people about my own importance, I also let them know that my two opponents were dreadful. Just utter bastards.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/V2Tew7FZ2Hp7P7GrdsAJ6D-1920-80.png

This worked alarmingly well. Did you know you can just ask people for money and get it? I might try this out in real life. Just a few minutes in, my very first beg netted me some silver pieces and well-wishes.

The issue was not the effectiveness of my tactics but my complete unfamiliarity with the videogame 'World of Warcraft'. I quickly realised that I had genuinely no idea what the relative value of these coins were . Is a silver piece nothing? Is it a billion dollars? Am I the richest man in MMO history already?

Likewise, simple mechanics hamstrung me. Did you know to actually get into The Undercity there's a whole elevator system? I didn't! So instead I just sort of roamed around the top part for a while, unsure what kind of zone I was even in. This was, on reflection, not a lucrative use of my time.

The highlights of my adventure? I'll be honest, I mostly just had a pleasant time ambling from town to town and asking people to give money to the world's most important man (me). This did backfire once, though.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xTYArAPbLraeakyrb6a42a-1920-80.png

In dialogue with one player, Zippie Skadoo, I referred to him as a "good man" (or maybe "good friend," I forget). It turns out this was not acceptable. Zippie Skadoo quickly educated me that he was, in fact, bad to the bone, on the verge of going berserk, and might be inclined to assault me.
So that could have gone better.
Elsewise? I reckon I could have won this thing had I not wasted time in A) The Undercity and B) taking a boat or something to another continent and getting repeatedly killed by panthers for a bit.
Lessons for next time, I suppose, when Majestic Celebrity once again graces… Azeroth(?) with his presence.

I've been playing WoW off and on since 2004. So you'd think I'd find this challenge a doddle. Nope! This was, and I am not prone to exaggeration, the worst two hours of… if not my entire life, at least this month.

OK, so, I didn't have a plan. Or rather, my plan was to tell everyone I had an amazing plan, in the hope that an amazing plan would just pop into my brain. It did not. What actually happened was I rushed headfirst into insanity. It's a good thing the video accompanying this is short, because I really don't want the world to see the extent of my madness.
At one point, I just started making animal noises.

After failing to prepare a plan, I decided to simply skin a bunch of critters and make money that way. Perhaps selling them to generous players. Easy, right? Obviously not, or I'd still have my sanity. I have listened back to my full recording and plucked out some choice quotes.

So, yeah, I had a great fucking time . And then I had to listen to my two-hour descent into madness. Which, let me tell you, was not fun! I got to relive the experience of wasting time and money when I should have been making money.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EBsdDhdbiAJMWnjYbPJ9e8-1920-80.png

At one point, I spent about 20 minutes trying to complete a single quest, which I should add only promised a reward of two silver. I never really dipped into WoW Classic, so I forgot how unforgiving OG WoW was. I'm not used to being a weak baby who will die as soon as a large bird or boisterous pig-man so much as looks at me. And I was already tired and annoyed by this point. I could have moved on. But I was determined to complete this stupid bloody quest. And I did it! I got my two silver.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever drops the PvP grind so normal people can have fancy titles too
items.summary: Blizzard outlines how PvP ranks will work in the throwback MMO.

content.v: Even though I was way too new (and low level) to understand how PvP worked in World of Warcraft's early days, I knew by osmosis that it was made for tryhards. WoW PvP was not only a massive grind, but a competition against other grinders for a unique title that no normal person would even dare to go for.

WoW: Forever borrows a lot from the classic game, but the torturous PvP system won't be one of them. In a new blog post , Blizzard explains how it has simplified the system overall to avoid asking players to derail their entire lives for bragging rights.

Those old titles are still there—High Warlord for Horde players and Grand Marshal for Alliance—but you won't be racing to keep your place on an invisible leaderboard every week. Instead, it's going to be pretty straight forward: Anyone who plays a lot of PvP will get rewarded eventually.

You'll have a currency and a point-based progression system to worry about. Honor is the currency you'll earn for killing enemy players, completing battlegrounds, and finishing PvP quests. Blizzard says it has normalized Honor gains across all the different battlegrounds so that none of them are more efficient than the others. As you do all of those things, you'll earn Rank points that unlock 14 tiers of rewards, which include powerful PvP gear and those flashy, prestigious titles. Rank points will have a weekly cap, too, so you can't just marathon to the end over a weekend.

All of this will be wrapped up in a PvP season that will reset once a new one starts, presumably to let Blizzard add a fresh set of rewards encouraging players to do the climb all over again. Every season will have weekly tasks that will give you bonus Honor and Rank points as well as a Legacy Point, Forever's account-wide meta progression system.

While I'm sure the most hardcore WoW veterans will scoff at the idea of normies running around with fancy PvP gear and titles, I don't think it would be responsible of Blizzard to ask people to stay up for multiple days trying to maintain their place on a leaderboard. Back in the old days, the system incentivized people to share their accounts with friends or guildmates just to keep up. The new system, while still a grind, follows Forever's general ethos of capturing the spirit of the old MMO while making it realistic for people who can't spend every waking moment of their lives logged in.

items.title: Call of Duty Esports Commentator Resigns After Pursuing Relationship With Co-Commentator's Ex-Wife
items.summary: A prominent Call of Duty esports commentator has opted to resign from his role after pursuing a romantic relat

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/20/mw4-mp-1787240916718.jpg
A prominent Call of Duty esports commentator has opted to resign from his role after pursuing a romantic relationship with his co-commentator's ex-wife.

In what is one of the most unique stories of the week, Call of Duty League commentator Clint "Maven" Evans has announced that he's stepping away from the CDL for the "foreseeable future." He noted that this decision came after he chose to pursue a romantic relationship with the wife of his co-commentator, Joseph "MerK" DeLuca. Evans noted that he recognized that the situation is "taboo" and "unconventional" in a statement.

"As some of you know, I was very close to my casting partner Joe and his family," Evans wrote. "Maurisa was one of my best friends. We remained friends, after they divorced, and along the way it became more than that and we started dating. I understand how unconventional/taboo it is. It’s truly not something I ever foresaw happening."
He went on to note that he hopes to return to the CDL in the future, but has acknowledged that it may not happen.

"I hope that one day I’ll be back working on the CDL," he continued. "If not, it was a hell of a ride, and I appreciate the love over the years. Please continue to show support to Joe, the CDL, and its talent!"

Naturally, the Call of Duty e-sports community has had some very intense reactions to the news. Many feel that Evans betrayed his friend, whom he has known for well over a decade. DeLuca hasn't commented on the situation and hasn't posted on his X page since October 4. The start date for the upcoming CDL season has yet to be formally announced, but historically, it begins in December, shortly after the latest Call of Duty is released.

items.title: Skate has been de-live serviced by ReSkate, a modding platform downloaded 350,000 times—devs say they will comply if EA's lawyers come knocking
items.summary: ReSkate makes Skate playable offline, and enables custom servers and maps. It's been an instant hit.

content.v: What's going on?

EA's reboot of the Skate series is a free-to-play online game with mixed user reviews on Steam . Aspects of Skate are well-liked, but a common complaint is that it lacks the spirit of skate culture, exchanging grittiness for brand-name premium cosmetics and tidy-looking maps in an online-only ecosystem that prevents true DIY modding.

Enter ReSkate , a new "modding platform" created (with AI assistance) by a pair of coders who go by zee_x64 and ReGlitched. The modders have experience with other custom server projects, namely R5Reloaded , which allows free-to-play shooter Apex Legends to be modded and played privately.

In just a few days, ReSkate was downloaded from GitHub over 350,000 times. The software hooks into a particular version of Skate on Steam and allows it to be played offline, in custom servers, and with custom maps and other assets.
"Honestly didn't realize how big this was going to be," zee_x64 told PC Gamer over Discord this week. "We were just doing it for the love of the game."
We were just doing it for the love of the game.
zee_x64, ReSkate modder

The modders say they aren't trying to undermine Skate developer Full Circle or "replace the live game," and have no personal issues with Skate's microtransactions. "For me the game is free to play and they need to make money somehow to be able to keep developing the game," zee_x64 said.

To that end, ReSkate will only work with the current version of Skate and isn't being promoted as a way to get premium content for free. Mods that unlock premium cosmetics are disallowed, at least in ReSkate's official channels.

Still, ReSkate does allow us to download a free-to-play game and then break out of its walled ecosystem, adding our own cosmetics and custom maps, and playing it without the need for EA's servers and anticheat software, which also makes it playable on Linux via Valve's Proton emulation. (But does not make it possible to cheat in official servers, because ReSkate doesn't interact at all with EA's servers.)

Lawyers have sent letters over less, and if EA comes knocking with a cease and desist order, zee_x64 says they won't put up a fight. But ReSkate is open source, and there are already over 70 forks on GitHub , so it may not be something that can be put back in the box.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sfLMXAPYVfag9zRTCgGPhG-1920-80.png
The player response

On the unofficial Skate subreddit, players are posting videos of custom cosmetics and maps—Counter-Strike maps made it in immediately, of course—and debating what ReSkate's effect on the live game will be.

One person is excited simply to have the option to choose any shirt color for their avatar. "The fact I can just open up a modding tool app; design the material type; design the colour; and not wait for the devs to release a specific version and wait for it to release on rotation is just great," they wrote .

Others are less convinced that ReSkate is a boon, with some expressing sympathy for Skate's developers on the expectation that the platform will negatively affect the game's future. One popular comment speculates that EA could come to "see [Skate] as a failed experiment and shuffle resources elsewhere."
At the time of writing, EA has not commented publicly on ReSkate.
AI tools sped up development

Custom server projects for defunct MMOs and long-running live service games have been a thing for a long time, but they aren't typically released while a game is still in early access. A 2026 wrinkle in this particular case is that the modders say development was substantially accelerated by AI coding tools.

"We used AI to help reverse [engineer] the game as I don't see any reason not to when the tooling exists," zee_x64 said. "Without it, it probably would of taken years to do the same thing … that also doesn't mean we blindly just prompted AI until it worked, we still had to use our previous knowledge to get it actually working."
Antivirus flags complicate the install

A heads-up for potential ReSkate downloaders: Windows antivirus doesn't like it, and you may have to create an exception for the file to avoid it being quarantined, an uncomfortable step despite the modders' assurance that it is a false positive.

"Some antivirus software may flag ReSkate because it uses techniques that can resemble malware, such as DLL injection, process/memory modification, and downloading files over HTTPS," says kushWRA1TH, a mod in ReSkate's Discord server . "These are used for its game-mod functionality and do not by themselves mean ReSkate is malicious."
Even if ReSkate itself is not malicious, downloading and using it does carry a risk, as it could contain exploitable security flaws. (As can any software.)

The modders note as well that they cannot vouch for every fork of the code, referring to versions created by people other than the original modders. As an open source project , ReSkate's inner-workings are available for anyone to analyze or modify.

items.title: Resident Evil Movie Will Become Zach Cregger’s Biggest Ever, Surpassing Weapons
items.summary: Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by

content.v: Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by revenue at the box office.

According to Deadline , Resident Evil is expected to surpass his current biggest movie, Weapons ($270 million worldwide), by the end of this week or sooner. It currently stands at $247.6 million worldwide.

What's propelling Resident Evil higher was its release in China this week--it debuted there on October 5, and it's expected to make $35 million in China for its first week. If this comes to fruition, Resident Evil should pass $280 million globally this week.

The previous Resident Evil movies from director Paul W.S. Anderson also performed phenomenally in China. The last one, 2016's The Final Chapter, made $159.5 million in China alone, making up more than 51% of the movie's worldwide gross of $312.2 million. It's the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever. Cregger's Resident Evil still has work to do to catch up.
Cregger's earlier movie, 2022's Barbarian, made $46 million worldwide. Long before that, Cregger made Miss March, and it earned $4.6 million worldwide.
In terms of all video game movies, Resident Evil ranks No. 17 , but if it does indeed reach $280 million, it will pass 2018's Tomb Raider ($274.6 million worldwide).

Resident Evil is doing great commercially and scored solid reviews from critics, so people might expect a sequel. That could happen, but Cregger has said he's finished with franchise movies , even though he does have ideas for more stories .
Cregger's next movie is The Flood, a deep-space sci-fi movie starring Jennifer Lawrence. It has nothing to do with Halo , despite bearing a name with ties to Halo .

items.title: What’s Next For Halo Under Activision? Probably Not The Endless
items.summary: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revea

content.v: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revealed, though it's unclear what role, if any, they will play going forward.

As announced last month by Xbox's Matt Booty, Halo is under new management , with the responsibility of the next game in the series going to a completely new team under Activision. Halo Studios, formerly 343 Industries, will remain as a small team to oversee already-released titles like the recent Halo: Campaign Evolved. However, the majority of the studio, 268 people, have been laid off.

In the wake of the news, the latest (and now last) issue of the lore-focused Canon Fodder blog written by Halo Studios community writer Alex Wakeford has now become a parting gift from the studio to the community. In it, Wakeford reveals a glimpse at what the future of Halo might have looked like under Halo Studios' continued stewardship.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/XalanynEmergence.jpg?w=636

There are plenty of reveals within, including a look at Zeta Halo environments that may have at one time been planned for Halo Infinite DLC. But the biggest reveal is saved for last: an image that is the community's first full look at the Endless. This new enemy faction was teased in Halo Infinite via the Harbinger, a member of an advanced race that was imprisoned by the Forerunners on Zeta Halo due to their ability to survive the firing of the Halo rings.

In the blog the Endless are referred to as the Xalanyn, children of Abaddon. Wakeford doesn't elaborate further, but states that he hopes the image will "spark your imagination and let your canon curiosities run wild with endless questions."

Each member of the Endless looks wildly different. Some appear vaguely humanoid, while others look more like some type of sea creature. Every Endless member appears alongside a smaller creature that is reminiscent of their Endless counterpart. The Harbinger appears in the image alongside a Skimmer, a new enemy type encountered in Halo Infinite.

The image seems to point towards the Endless being almost a replacement of sorts for Halo's traditional Covenant faction, with each Endless supplying a smaller enemy type the Master Chief would have to battle against. Interestingly, an Engineer, an alien race used by the Covenant and seen in previous entries in the franchise, appears alongside a similar looking Endless in the image. This looks to imply the Engineers themselves were created or in some way linked to the Endless.

Unfortunately, this may be Halo fans' first, and last, look at the Endless. According to Halo insider Rebs Gaming , nobody at Halo Studios is currently involved in Activision's new Halo . Activision may completely disregard Halo Studios' work in favor of a clean slate , though Rebs does state Activision's game, while not a direct sequel to Halo Infinite, also won't "retcon any previously established canon."

Halo's move to Activision comes as Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has put a renewed emphasis on big franchises as part of her "Xbox reset" strategy that has seen widespread layoffs , game cancellations, and studio divestitures.

items.title: Gears of War E-Day Is a 'Natural Choice to Be an Exclusive' – Studio Head Mike Crump Claims Series Carries the Banner for Xbox

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/01/gears-1790854472442.jpg

Gears of War: E-Day launched this week, and while it is excellent, the game was pulled away from a PS5 launch earlier this year. In a recent interview, The Coalition Studio Head Mike Crump claims that this was all part of the plan.

In an interview with the BBC , Crump defended the choice to be an Xbox exclusive, despite a likely ludicrous budget saying, "Gears has been an exclusive franchise to Xbox for 20 years now. It's sort of entwined deeply with the brand."

However, Gears of War: Reloaded did launch on PS5 last year, so the franchise as a whole isn't exactly Xbox-exclusive anymore. It's also likely that if E-Day did launch on PlayStation, it'd see higher sales numbers.

Crump claims that the metrics for success go further than that, though. He told the BBC that the series is meant to, at least in part, carry the banner for the Xbox platform and give people a "reason to be in the Xbox ecosystem." Queue Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's decision to pull the game from the PS5 release slate.

Regardless, the game will now likely have lower sales than it otherwise would have. When the BBC asked Crump about that, he insisted that the studio is taking a broader view than just looking at sales figures and retention numbers.

"We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to it limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? ...Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware," he answered.

If the goal is to be a tech demo about what the Xbox consoles are capable of, I'd argue that it's a straight-up success. The game looks incredible on both the Xbox Series X and Series S, so much so that The Coalition had to rely on trickery with the Page File to get the game running smoothly on the less-powerful console. The game is also incredible, and our reviewer Ryan McCaffrey gave it a 9 , saying:

"By going back to the beginning, Gears of War: E-Day returns to the heart of this series: Marcus Fenix, Dom Santiago, and a Locust horde that’s as terrifying as it is dangerous. E-Day pulls off the tightrope act of giving us a heartfelt prequel with strong characters even when we know how it ends. On a more mechanical level, it also evolves the enemies, weapons, and combat you’d expect to deliver a Gears of War campaign that stands toe-to-toe with any of the others. It wraps up with 10 years still left to go before Marcus gets tossed in prison ahead of the events of the first Gears of War, so here’s hoping the next one stays in the past for a while longer – and that we don’t have to wait another seven years for it to arrive."

But even if the game is a critical hit and a technical marvel, sales numbers will inevitably play a role in the game's success, especially as Microsoft is currently in the middle of a months-long restructuring campaign. Right after launch, developers at The Coalition told Eurogamer they were expecting layoffs. However, Crump has since addressed those concerns , saying, "For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that."
Let's just hope that a pretty game and high review scores really are enough to keep the Xbox layoff machine at bay.

items.title: Capcom Clarifies Stance on AI After RE Engine Conference Comments
items.summary: Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom has clarified its stance on AI and its future plans for the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/capcom-clarifies-stance-on-ai-1791395067864.jpg
Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom has clarified its stance on AI and its future plans for the RE Engine in an exclusive conversation with IGN.

Capcom held its yearly recruitment conference on October 2, wherein programmer Satoshi Ishida outlined the company’s plans to incrementally improve its RE Engine using a program called REX (short for RE Next Engine).

Rather than building a new engine from scrap, Ishida explained that a series of steps will be taken to improve the RE Engine piece by piece. This includes the use of AI, which gave fans pause after the news broke online.

We bent the ear of a spokesperson at Capcom, who laid out the challenges its developers are currently facing that led the company to rethink how it makes games with the RE Engine. They confirmed that games are becoming increasingly colossal undertakings, to the point where titles now take up immense amounts of time and resources to create. With AI being a swiftly-advancing technology, Capcom saw the opportunity to use it to solve these issues and make its developers more efficient by improving their development tools, testing game code for them, and analyzing large chunks of data on their behalf, as well as other helpful benefits.

Capcom’s vision for REX is to implement these AI tools and efficiencies into the next iteration of the RE Engine to help the company make games faster with the strongest tools available to it. The spokesperson told us that Capcom has no plans to use generative AI in the creation of its games (which creates content based on a prompt, as opposed to other types of AI that are used to analyze patterns, make predictions, process data, etc.). Any AI used with the RE Engine will be for the express purpose of speeding up processes and helping development teams be more efficient.

This means that AI will not be used for creating assets or programs in games. Capcom said as much back in March during a shareholders’ meeting , where the company was asked how it intends to use artificial intelligence in its products.

“We will not implement assets generated by AI into our games.” Capcom said. “However, we plan to proactively use it as a contributing technology to improve the efficiency and productivity of the game development process. To this end, we are currently exploring ways to implement it in various areas, including graphics, sound and programming."
Upcoming Capcom games include Resident Evil Veronica and Mega Man: Dual Override.

items.summary: Star Wars Zero Company released in late August to great reviews, but its launch was bittersweet, as a large ch

content.v: Star Wars Zero Company released in late August to great reviews, but its launch was bittersweet, as a large chunk of developer Bit Reactor's staff was furloughed , unsure if they would be returning to work. For at least a portion of them, however, that uncertainty is over, as they're back at the studio.

Speaking to Game File , Bit Reactor CEO Greg Foertsch said the studio had "started the process of returning more of our team back to work" but stopped short of giving specific percentages or figures. Game File's sources said the headcount following this return is more than half of what is was pre-furlough, but it's unclear when or if more staff will return in the future. A lawsuit involving Foertsch and co-founder Alison Kelly is currently ongoing, as well.

Games in genres as niche as turn-based tactics can sometimes struggle to make a major impact, but Star Wars Zero Company is about as good as these games get. Alongside a surprisingly approachable prequel-era story, the game mixes classic XCOM-style combat with some unique Star Wars twists, like force-pulling enemies out of cover so they can be obliterated by your blasters.

In our Star Wars Zero Company review , Steve Watts called it "the next great evolution of the genre." For a different twist on Star Wars once you're finished with Zero Company, you can now grab the excellent Star Wars Galactic Racer , as well.

items.title: Cities: Skylines Announced For Switch 2 While Sequel’s Console Ports Are Still MIA
items.summary: Paradox Interactive has announced Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Colossal Or

content.v: Paradox Interactive has announced Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Colossal Order's hit 2015 city-builder. While it's great to see Cities: Skylines make its way to a new platform, this announcement also serves as a reminder that we have no idea when the long-awaited console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 will come out.

Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition was developed by Tantalus Media, the team behind The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword's Switch port . It'll cost $49, include 10 expansions, expand the buildable area to 25 tiles, support keyboard and mouse, and add a map editor, plus better precision placement and environmental controls. Players can choose between a 30fps mode that focuses on visual quality or a performance mode targeting 60fps.

The Switch 2 port launches on October 28 and will be available at a 70% discount to those who already own the Switch 1 version. Holiday Getaways, Mansions & Manors, and Blueprint Beasts Radio content creator packs will be released for the PC, PS4, and Xbox One versions of the game on the same day.

While the original Cities: Skylines continues to be updated and ported to new platforms, Cities: Skylines 2 and its prospective console ports have had a much rockier journey. That sequel was supposed to be released the same day on PC and console in October 2023, but the console ports were pushed back to Spring 2024 ahead of release. When the PC version of Cities: Skylines 2 launched, it was riddled with bugs and other issues, and developer Colossal Order spent months fixing them.

In Spring 2024, the console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 were delayed again, this time to October 2024. Unfortunately, the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S ports were delayed again, and the developers admitted , "We have not yet met the stability and performance targets we set for the console release." Over two years later, the port is still not out.

In November 2025, Iceflake Studios took over development of Cities: Skylines 2 from Colossal Order, teasing that it will do "continuous work on the Editor and console editions." We have not heard anything about console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 since then.

As Tanatlus Media developed Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition for Switch 2, not Iceflake Studios, it's unlikely the releases are connected in any significant way. Still, the status of the Cities: Skylines 2 console ports remains a mystery, further complicated by this Switch 2 port announcement and the reveal of Lego Skylines for PC and console.

items.title: WoW: Forever Players Love It When Things Look Old
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players have made their feelings about the game's visual style crystal clear: They

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever players have made their feelings about the game's visual style crystal clear: They love it when things look old.

It's a recurring theme in the Forever beta, where players have continually pushed back against updated high-definition character models and character portraits. While Forever is in many ways a new version of Blizzard's MMORPG, it's built with the spirit and foundation of WoW Classic in mind, even as it includes updated visuals and quality-of-life updates taken straight from modern WoW. One of those new features is an option to use modern WoW's updated playable character and non-enemy NPC models.

According to the WoW content creator Savix , who tested an early version of Forever before it was publicly announced, developer Blizzard didn't originally plan to include the ability to swap between standard or high-def character models, instead only using HD models. The testers, many of them streamers and content creators from within the WoW Classic community, stressed how important it was to include an option for the game's original character models.

Blizzard thankfully listened, but every other instance of updated character models have been met with similar distaste from among the MMO's community. Whether it was intentional or by mistake, a quilboar boss was found to be using its modern WoW model and was met with backlash from players. It didn't take long for Blizzard to return the enemy back to how it looked in WoW Classic.

It's a similar story with the game's character creation portraits. For much of the beta, the Forever character-creation screen used HD portraits taken from modern WoW, to the disappointment of the community. Earlier this week that finally changed , with the game now using WoW's original character-creation portraits.

Blizzard seems to have gotten the message. Currently, the game's new playable Skyborne elf race only has HD models. That, too, sounds like it will soon change. In a comment attached to a video exploring Skyborne lore and abilities, Blizzard said to "stay tuned regarding Skyborne models," seemingly implying standard-definition versions of the Skyborne are on the way.

Even with these options, some players want more. Forever's user interface is a fascinating combination of old and new--cleaner and more streamlined similar to modern WoW, but inspired in many ways by WoW Classic. Currently, there's not a toggle option to swap between Forever's updated UI and WoW's original interface. For those who want the UI as it was 20 years ago, a player-made ClassicUI Forever add-on reverts many of Blizzard's changes to make everything from the game's action bars, spellbook, profession tab, character portraits, bags, and more look as they did in 2004.

I expect this push and pull to continue. WoW content creators have debated the clash between old and new found in Forever's art style, with many calling on Blizzard to pick a lane. For what seems like the majority of the Forever community, the answer is loud and clear--the older looking the better.

WoW: Forever's beta runs through October 21, with Forever's full launch coming November 4. A recent RMT controversy in the Forever beta saw Blizzard put its foot down when it comes to illegal gold buying . Meanwhile, Blizzard is asking players in a survey for their opinions on 11 potential new classes that could be added to Forever in the future.

items.title: FBI Arrests 29-Year-Old Alabama Man After Epic Reported Fortnite Voice Chat Threats
items.summary: The FBI arrested a Fortnite player last week after Epic reported threats he made over voice chat.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/fortnite-1791394391574.jpg
The FBI arrested a Fortnite player last week after Epic reported threats he made over voice chat.
Epic reported Edward Frith, an avid Fortnite player from Alabama, over alarming messages spoken while playing Fortnite. He was later arrested when the FBI turned up at his house.

According to the affidavit (reported by Aftermath ), Frith, who went by the username “WagesOfNinja,” said he was letting all his rage out because he wanted to “literally murder somebody” and that he thinks about killing “every day.”

"Let's see if the FBI is going to show up at my door because I'll shoot them motherf****rs too," Frith said, before the FBI showed up at his door. Frith’s other comments were just as disturbing, with the Fortnite player suggesting he was planning to end his life by charging at police.

Epic made what was described as a "voluntary emergency disclosure" to the FBI National Threat Operations Section (NTOS) Exigent Threat Research and Analysis Crisis Team (EXTRACT), relating to the statements. The developer then provided the FBI with an audio recording and transcript of the threats.

The Alabama resident was indicted for violating Interstate Threatening Communications on September 23. He was remanded into custody while awaiting a trial, after entering a plea of “not guilty” on September 24.

Epic Games announced a new voice reporting system for Fortnite in November 2023 . The system allows players to clip audio and anonymously file a report whenever they catch another player violating the community rules.

"The only way Epic ever receives a copy of the audio clip is if voice reporting is on and a participant affirmatively reports the voice chat using the in-game voice reporting feature,” Epic said at the time.

Once reported, the last five minutes of communications are captured and the audio file is sent to Epic’s moderation team to review. Depending on the severity of the communications, players can face bans or, in this case, being reported to the feds.

Likewise, Fortnite players can report text chat, which is stored for 30 days. The Fortnite developer also uses autonomous systems to detect harmful language, such as “self-harm, child endangerment, and threats of real-world violence.”
Photo by Jakub Porzycki/NurPhoto via Getty Images.

items.title: Help, I have been abducted by a tiny car and cannot escape
items.summary: Also, where are the deer?

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

The diary of my time with Grand Theft Auto 5 so far consists, in the main, of struggles with cars. The perfidious automobile, the horseless carriage, has run rampant in Los Santos for weeks now, causing all manner of chaos as I attempt to live my life and do backflips and what-have-you.

Time to put them in their place. To do so, I have utilised Toy Cars – Make any car tiny , whose nature is right there in the name. The pitch is that you can transform any car you drive into its Micro Machines equivalent, shrinking them down to fit in a child's hand, keeping "your original vehicle visible, sounding, and behaving like itself while using a hidden RC-sized chassis underneath to provide miniature collision, suspension, and road physics."
This is not quite how it goes for me.

As ever, this is not the mod's fault. It seems to work well. After teleporting my way into a car (they are mostly too airborne to hijack normally), I drive around a bit and tap F7—the magic car-shrinking key. This is where it all goes to pot, you see.

The shrinking bit? Works great. My car—a taxi—instantly transmogrifies, becoming a Lilliputian equivalent of itself. Then it all goes off the rails. Somehow, for reasons that will forever be beyond me, I think the game stops registering the car as having a driver. If it's not a player-character vehicle, it suddenly becomes subject to the laws (or lack of laws) that govern every other car in the game: it careens off like a scared horse, bouncing off walls, ducking under low arches.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xpjwMHYPrW2qSBFXceDHdK-1920-80.gif

It is entirely beyond my control and I cannot get out. If I hit F—the traditional button for exiting a car—a notification pops up that there are no deer nearby. This is saddening news but not immediately relevant to my being taken hostage by a car.

Fortunately, I can return the car back to scale with another tap of the F7 key, but I am somewhat sad. For a moment there, I thought I could live the Borrower life I always dreamt of. Maybe some other time.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA-1920-80.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 Wants Losing Your Wanted Level To Feel Like A “Hit-And-Run”
items.summary: Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of

content.v: Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of Leonida are in luck, with Rockstar confirming in a recent interview that Jason and Lucia can do far more than escape a glowing red zone on the map to shake off the law.

Speaking to IGN ahead of the Netflix Extended Look back in August, head of development and co-studio head Rob Nelson walked the outlet through a 30-minute gameplay demo in which several new mechanics and locations were detailed.

The demo begins in Jason and Lucia’s safehouse, one of many interactive personal spaces the player can call home in GTA 6. Here you can switch characters, partake in unique interactions, or even decorate the place to suit your style. However, Rockstar has stressed “this is not their own house, they’re staying in someone else’s house.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_02.jpg?w=636

From here, Nelson takes Lucia on a stroll through downtown where an evolved version of Red Dead Redemption 2 ’s NPC interaction system is used to mess with random citizens, which can range from dangerous gangbangers to normal people jogging in the local park.

But now these interactions possess significantly more depth and go far beyond saying hello, being rude, or holding someone at gunpoint. Rockstar describes several examples such as eavesdropping on a conversation for too long and being called out, or following an NPC as he goes about his regular routine only for it to blow up into a moment that feels earned and can be tackled in a multitude of ways.

This is where the evolved wanted level system comes into play, although Rockstar has made it clear that you will still have an opportunity to cause untold chaos and murder hundreds of cops if you’re that way inclined, but doing so will come with significantly more variables since Rockstar doesn’t want GTA 6 to make you “all-powerful” like GTA 5 often did .

After an interaction ends with an NPC pulling a gun on Lucia and a group of people she has just interacted with, dispatch is called and a one-star wanted level star shows up on screen. If you manage to escape the area where the authorities are going to respond, you’ll be in the clear, but Nelson goes on to describe a number of ways this can be achieved.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_11_ef0290.jpg?w=636

“As much as possible, we tried to design the game so that you have options,” Nelson said. “Things can escalate quite quickly if you want them to, or people who don’t want to escalate can try to avoid it. It's not always possible! To me, that supports the narrative. This is a story about a couple on the run. We have tried to make the systems and the design support our narrative when and wherever possible. Meaning, if you hit and run, commit a crime and run, get into trouble and move on before the cops get there, and you don’t start shooting people, don't start escalating – which you absolutely can do if you want to – but if you don’t, you’re generally going to be fine.”

Nelson expands upon this system further after Lucia experiences another NPC interaction that puts the fuzz on her tail. Even if you haven’t killed someone, a stolen vehicle or beaten and bruised pedestrian is still going to raise both eyebrows and your wanted level. You can run away the old fashioned way, or decide to get a haircut, change your outfit, or even split up if Jason and Lucia happen to be travelling together.

“Again, if I take off here, I should be fine. We’re really trying to encourage this hit-and-run style of gameplay.” Nelson explains. “So, the police are looking for me. We have this heat system, and they know what I look like and what I’m wearing. Here’s a pair of glasses–I'll put on this and this baseball hat. But they still know what I'm wearing, so I would need to go to a clothing store or call my personal vehicle, which has changes of outfits in the trunk.”

The idea of being able to lose the law by dashing into an interconnected network of alleys or blending in amidst NPCs in a random storefront sounds thrilling, especially dynamic systems designed to keep you on their toes are constantly interacting with one another.

Outfits can become compromised, while cops will be quick to recognise what vehicle you’re travelling in or where you were last seen. But Nelson notes that “so long as you don’t draw too much attention to yourself, you should be fine.” Easier said than done in an open world as ripe with possibility as this one.
GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and according to reports it is already close to 6 million pre-orders more than a month before launch.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass 将于 10 月推出《战争机器：E-Day》和这 11 款游戏
items.summary: It's the start of a new month, and like clockwork, the next batch of Xbox Game Pass titles has been announced

content.v: It's the start of a new month, and like clockwork, the next batch of Xbox Game Pass titles has been announced for the subscription service. Gears of War: E-Day leads the new arrivals this month, and it'll be joined by a few more big games: Battlefield 6 and Valor Mortis.
Here's a closer look at everything you can grab in the first half of the month through Xbox Game Pass:

The headline act is the aforementioned Gears of War: E-Day , a pretty great Xbox console exclusive if you're looking for something gleefully loud, dumb, and violent. Minecraft Dungeons 2 has also just launched, and while it does have a few flaws, it's a lot more ambitious than its predecessor.

Other notable games in this first wave include the day-one release of Echo Weaver, an adventure game where time is your greatest resource, and Forever Ago, another brand-new release focused on redemption as you set off on a single-player road trip adventure.

Arriving on October 13, Game Pass Ultimate subscribers can check out large-scale warfare with Battlefield 6 , while Valor Mortis is a first-person soulslike set during the Napoleonic Wars era. If you feel like something that's less brutal, Deep Dish Dungeon is a survival exploration game with hand-crafted dungeons and metroidvania elements.

Rounding out the first wave of games on October 15 are several more day-one titles that cover a wide range of genres. You can shoot the Heeler family--with a camera, you sicko--in the day-one release of Bluey's Happy Snaps , and Chained Beasts is a co-op gladiator roguelike. You'll fight side by side with your comrade in arms and chains.
Finally, you can build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist with it as you explore the cosmos in the day-one release of Beyond These Stars.
Several games are also leaving Game Pass on October 15, so you have only a few more days to try titles like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 and Evil West.

items.title: For a moment it looked like Grand Theft Auto 6 might be playable on PC on launch day—then Xbox's chief strategy officer crashed the party
items.summary: A report that GTA 6 would be streamable on PC turned out to be a bit off the mark.

content.v: We still don't have a PC launch date for Grand Theft Auto 6 , or even official confirmation that it's ever going to come our way, even though we all know it is. But for one brief shining moment, fans on PC had hope that maybe they'd be able to backdoor their way into the cool kids club—that despite the absence of a PC version, they might be able to play it on November 19 anyway, without having to shell out for a new game console.
Alas, the word has come down from on high, and that word is: " No ."

The ball got rolling when The Verge reported on October 6 that Xbox had secured the exclusive right to deliver GTA 6 via streaming platforms—that is, Xbox Cloud Gaming. And that would presumably make the game playable on PC, as Xbox Cloud Gaming is accessible through any PC rocking Windows 10 version 20H2 or later.

Alas, it is now time to lock eyes with the metaphorical skull in your hand and ponder that dream, that faraway hope, and all that has brought them low—which in this case is Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball, who delivered the bad news on X .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v2ziKkjF7BYy7TADp9CivA-1920-80.png

"While the excitement for GTA 6 and Xbox is great to see, it has also led to some misreporting," Ball wrote. "We are looking forward to launching GTA 6 on Xbox November 19, though the game will not be streaming exclusively or to PC."

That's some real infinite jest, alright! Which I think is applicable to the whole situation: I actually buy the argument that it's better to develop a game of this scale within the constraints of consoles and then expand to the greater (and more unpredictable) power of PC later, and I have no doubt that Rockstar and Take-Two also enjoy the tighter constraints on the user end of things too: You're not going to find shenanigans like Joshua Wolens' effort to mod GTA 5 into GTA 6 in the worst way possible on a PlayStation 5, after all.

But I also think PCG's Ted Litchfield hit the nail on the head with his analysis : "Rockstar banks on a second revenue bump from its games' PC releases, a little afterburner of profit that includes no shortage of PC-favoring players who buy the game twice." There really is no dip like the double dip.

Anyway, some of the responses to Ball's message complain that the message is vague or ambiguous, although I'm not sure how: There are questions, sure, most obviously how Xbox will stream GTA 6 without making it accessible to PCs that can normally access streamed Xbox games. It's a fair point, and I suppose if one has an inflated sense of optimism and squints at the statement just right, a faint glimmer of that hope might remain. But to me, 'will not be streaming to PC' seems pretty cut-and-dried: Our long, wintry wait will continue.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kkNtsnEsZiTdgmuFTn4pJ6-1920-80.jpg

items.title: New Details Revealed For GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia, Including “Physical Intimacy”
items.summary: New information has come to light about GTA 6 , and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason

content.v: New information has come to light about GTA 6 , and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason and Lucia . In GTA 6, they are both partners in crime and lovers, and physical intimacy will be part of the experience, it seems.

Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said in an interview with IGN that physical intimacy is a "huge part" of a relationship, and that applies to GTA 6. Exactly how this may operate in GTA 6, however, remains a mystery. "It has to be done right," Nelson said.
"Like anything that we do, we have to iterate and try things and iterate on it until we figure out what feels right," he explained.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_03.jpg?w=636

GTA 6's ESRB rating says the game will have nudity and strong sexual content, and IGN reported that when switching characters, it can switch to Jason's POV while he is naked and in the shower. An international rating for GTA 6 specifically mentions how the game will have "sex scenes."

The GTA series has had its fair share of sex-related controversy. One of gaming’s biggest controversies ever, the Hot Coffee surrounding GTA: San Andreas saw Rockstar owner Take-Two paying out money to settle suits related to a mod in GTA: San Andreas’ PC edition that unlocked an interactive sex minigame .
As of yet, there is no indication that any sex scenes in GTA 6 would be interactive.
Also in the interview, Nelson discussed Jason and Lucia's relationship generally, saying players will be able to "role-play" their relationship, and "it's amazing."

GTA 6's story is narratively structured around Jason and Lucia, and the two of them working together. They don't have to be a couple, though, and instead can be simply "partners in crime" who are not romantically involved.

"I don’t want to say too much more about this because I don’t want to spoil anything. It really adds a compelling element to things, and it’s one of the reasons we wanted to approach this sort of story, because it's completely different for us," he said. "Could we bring some sort of emotional resonance to GTA for people if they wanted to engage with it? Could we also provide mechanisms for people to just opt out of it if they're not into it? If they feel like, ‘I don't want a relationship in this?’ That's what we're going to find out. It's not something that we want to foist upon players."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_09-3.jpg?w=636

Nelson went on to say GTA 6 will not give players "a particular gameplay benefit" if they have Jason and Lucia become lovers, however. But they will always have the benefit of "working together and having each other's back," he said.

"Whether they're romantically close or not doesn't change that. They will still work together. It's really about what you want for them, their story, and how it plays out. Whether you've nurtured the relationship or not will definitely have a bearing on how their story plays out," Nelson explained.

GTA 6 has a dedicated "relationship system" that is separate from a different gameplay system that tracks what sort of a criminal you are, Nelson said. Players can nurture the relationship between Jason and Lucia in the ways you would expect, including spending time together with things like kayaking and mini-golf. Or they can grow their relationship by robbing stores together.
"However players want to spend that time together, it will have a positive impact on the relationship," he said.

GTA 6's narrative setup has been likened to Bonnie and Clyde, the famous real-world criminal couple who met their end in a hail of gunfire . Many are wondering if both Jason and Lucia will make it out alive in GTA 6, or at the least, how their relationship may be tested. Another popular fan theory is that either Jason or Lucia is actually working with the Feds and will turn on the other at some point.
it won't be much longer until we find out, as GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: PS5 版《极限竞速：地平线 6》推迟到 2027 年，所有平台的首个付费扩展包也随之发布
items.summary: Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a ne

content.v: Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a new report says the game has in fact been delayed to 2027. This has now been confirmed by Sony : Forza Horizon 6 will now release on January 26, 2027.

Reputable leaker billbil-kun originally said Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 was set for release on January 26, 2027, so that reporting was accurate. There will be a physical disc edition at retail, and the game will also be sold digitally.

Early access will start on January 21, for people who pay more to buy the game's Premium Edition. Developer Panic Button made the PS5 edition; that's the same studio behind the PS5 port of Forza Horizon 5. Playground Games and Turn 10 worked "in close collaboration" with Panic button on the ports.
Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 will have a 4K 30FPS "Quality" mode and a 60FPS "Performance" mode. The trailer above stems from the Quality mode.
All preorders for Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 include a pre-tuned Ferrari J50 that will show up in your garage after completing the prologue.
The PS5 edition will support cross-play and cross-saves with the Xbox and Steam versions. All of the Forza Horizon 6 user-generated content is available cross-platform, too.

Additionally, Microsoft announced that the first paid expansion for Forza Horizon 6 will launch on January 21, 2027. It's included with the game's Premium Edition, Premium Upgrade, and Expansions Bundle, or can be purchased separately (pricing was not confirmed). Microsoft did not provide any details on what's in the paid expansion, however. It's the first of two planned paid expansions.

Additionally, a free content update for all players on all platforms is coming to Forza Horizon 6 in 2027 for the launch of the PS5 edition and the expansion. "We will share more details about this closer to release," the studio said.
In September, Microsoft said in a blog post that the PS5 edition of the popular racing game was due for release in 2026, but plans have changed.

Forza Horizon 6 was released in May this year for Xbox Series X|S and PC. The game, which is set in Japan, scored rave reviews, including an 8/10 from GameSpot , and PlayStation fans have had to wait for their turn to play.

The last game in the series, Forza Horizon 5, was a huge hit on PlayStation 5 . In other Forza news, Microsoft recently announced that Forza developers Turn 10 and Playground are merging to become one unified studio to support and grow the brand going forward.

items.title: 什么叫“你可以在搜打撤里先打局牌了”？
items.summary: 狠活还得看你。 尽管我体验过许多射击游戏，也浅尝过一些注重策略的二游。但迄今为止，我还没有见过任何一部射击游戏作品，能让玩家“身临其境”，跟那些活灵活现的二次元角色并肩作战，还能指挥她们、给她们下命令，一同庆祝胜利的喜悦

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/2a51dd08a441a4b3d323978e97fdbbb4.appmsg_mw680water
狠活还得看你。
尽管我体验过许多射击游戏，也浅尝过一些注重策略的二游。但迄今为止，我还没有见过任何一部射击游戏作品，能让玩家“身临其境”，跟那些活灵活现的二次元角色并肩作战，还能指挥她们、给她们下命令，一同庆祝胜利的喜悦。
我也没想到，是《暗区突围》这部搜打撤游戏最终实现了这一点。
9月30日，《暗区突围》和《少女前线2》联动上线，除了实装一批外观，也有对应的 玩法设计 。在前不久上线的指挥官模式中，玩家可以分别将OTs-14（别称“黑闪电”）、可露凯这两位联动角色编入小队，在局内指挥她们战斗。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/7e453e73419d9f18788073d10f43dba1.appmsg_mw680water
可露凯是少前人气最高的角色之一
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/ebc299571db496768ce86ed03d47ba95.appmsg_mw680water
为OTs-14指定目标地点投掷燃烧弹
这样的体验真的像是少前世界观下的“战术人形”并肩作战，为我和不少玩家带来了前所未有的新鲜感和陪伴感。
而少前联动并不是《暗区突围》这个赛季整出的唯一狠活。自9月2日暗区第19赛季上线以来，集中在游戏性和内容玩法层面的更新频次很高、力度也大，先后推出了“硬核模式2.0”“指挥官模式”，还有一套衍生的休闲卡牌玩法“暗区：封锁线”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/4a113e385b9d7dfc2986f33a87674108.appmsg_mw680water
对的，现在玩家们可以在一部搜打撤游戏里打牌了。 硬核模式好歹算是对搜打撤硬核原教旨的忠实还原，指挥官模式也可以说是暗区主模式的外延产物。可是卡牌玩法，乍一看怎么都和搜打撤不沾边——
然而正是这些“有的没的”，跟少前联动一样起到了正面作用，也让暗区在S19的讨论热度持续上升，乃至有一批玩其他卡牌的玩家专门下载暗区准备“炸鱼”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/eae5a01bc31f4598be536af6254f2594.appmsg_mw680water
七麦数据显示，《暗区突围》在9月30日位列iOS畅销榜第8名
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/9cdf845c913d9146d5792ce34d2710f9.appmsg_mw680water
我们常说一部游戏不可能取悦所有人，对于天生自带硬核门槛的搜打撤而言尤甚。不过作为品类先驱者，《暗区突围》似乎研究出了一套满足不同生态位用户诉求的“整活”策略。
在射击游戏里打牌
暗区S19狠活频出，其中反响最热烈的就是打牌玩法 “暗区：封锁线” ，玩起来既容易上手又容易上头。
规则和常见的回合制卡组构建玩法类似，玩家要从指挥官、士兵卡、武器卡、命令牌等四大类型的卡牌中挑选构建自己的卡组，在对战中利用卡组获取优势，清空对方指挥官的血量，或是让对方牌库枯竭持续扣血。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/cf26c28592817ef460d65fc50d172100.appmsg_mw680water
这套玩法的深度，有一部分来源于阵线机制和武器系统的配合。
场上划分了三条阵线，包括敌我指挥官身处的行动区，以及战场中间的封锁区。装备步枪和狙击枪的单位，可以跨阵线攻击；装备手枪、冲锋枪和霰弹枪的单位，只能攻击邻近阵线的敌方单位，需要积极“上线”争抢封锁区。士兵卡一般自带武器，而武器卡可以给指挥官装备，带来额外的攻击次数和场面变数。
另一部分深度来源于丰富的词条和技能。首先武器本身就有衍生效果，像霰弹枪能一打多，而狙击枪不会遭到反击。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/a71e82d76ebe14d1db475af7fc76809c.appmsg_mw680water
然后是各种词条，效果很好理解，稍微接触过这类回合制卡牌对战的玩家，更是一眼就懂：“部署”就是上场触发效果的“战吼”，“成盒”就是死后触发效果的“亡语”，“掩护”是给相邻友军单位开嘲讽扛伤害，“双发”是一回合打两次，“防弹”是默认数值减伤……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/4bc72cb93de176f6861aeebb7e89c8fa.appmsg_mw680water
词条一览
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/d81bdb6f33123178bb67ddce1f22e9e0.appmsg_mw680water
门岗战神有“猛攻”加持，打出后可立即行动，适合前期快攻
指挥官和很大一部分单位拥有特殊技能，而命令牌也有如上Buff、解单位、直接攻击敌人指挥官等强力效果。由于打出卡牌要耗费行动点，指挥官技能又需要每回合留些行动点充能，所以这套玩法的实质还是拼卡牌性价比，即如何用最少的费用打出最好的效果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/e2741761b15cb2dc55db1b463c115cc4.appmsg_mw680water
托兰德技能是获取额外行动点，适合跳费打后期
为了让新手熟悉这套颇有深度的规则，游戏一上来会预设5套新手卡组。后续充实卡牌库存的过程，也在制造一条由浅入深的上手链路，打牌打输了也没啥惩罚，试错成本只有时间。
显然它非常适合填补碎片化时间，在频繁跑图略感疲惫的时候，满足休闲和放松的需求。 待到未来官方添加更多样化的卡牌、社区对卡组流派的理解完全成型，这套“暗牌”有成为《暗区突围》最耐玩衍生玩法的潜力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/5227d103851b830ad3cddd92fe522a40.appmsg_mw680water
“暗牌”推出后，官方也跟另一款卡牌游戏KARDS展开了友好互动
搜打撤的进化
在“暗牌”打响自己的名号之余，暗区没有忘记自己作为搜打撤FPS的本分， S19推出的指挥官模式和“硬核模式2.0”，均是对主体搜打撤玩法的深化。
指挥官模式允许玩家扮演指挥官，通过内置轮盘或语音指挥AI小队战斗，完成对局的搜打撤循环。
除少前联动限定的指挥官外，其余指挥官均为暗区世界观下的重要NPC，各自携带一支由AI士兵组成的队伍。队伍具备不同的装备配置与能力，对应NPC在剧情中的指挥战斗风格，适配不同玩家的游戏取向。
像阿贾克斯的“卫士”小队，携带盾牌稳步推进，注重防御。
多斯的小弟不擅长战斗，但是拥有四处搜刮并带回高价值物资的能力，擅长偷吃。
直接吃，快来吃，美滋滋
完成一批成长任务，还会升级小弟的装备和能力，变相提升撤离成功率。
这些小弟同样听从玩家的语音指挥，执行一些简单命令，从掩护、跟随、进攻，再到扫荡地图上的特定点位和房间。说句题外话，魔方工作室的AI语音指挥技术于2024年曝光，两年后在暗区的指挥官模式中落地，实现的效果却不同凡响。
所谓“指挥”不单单限定于游戏预设的指令清单，我还可以打开语音下一些比较复杂的命令，比如“在前面的树下警戒”“消灭别墅的敌人”“扫荡黄卡房”等。
至少证明了AI小弟真的忠诚
事实上，这套AI系统正在让许多未曾深入接触AI的玩家们钻研prompt（提示词）。例如“进攻”和“推进”两个指令就有区别，像阿贾克斯的持盾小弟，在“进攻”时会卸下盾牌鲁莽冲锋，但在收到“推进”指令时就会举盾稳步移动。再比如，很多人不明白如何让患有多动症的AI静步——但这首先需要指挥官/玩家以身作则，自己不露脚步才行。
AI语音指挥和指挥官模式的小队战斗相得益彰，强化了传统搜打撤玩法的策略性，靠AI小队的战斗博弈营造了有趣的差异化体验。可以想象，倘若AI技术继续发展下去，能为《暗区突围》乃至整个品类带来怎样的玩法进化。
同时暗区也在重现原汁原味的搜打撤体验，推出“硬核模式2.0”。
这个模式类似“怀旧服”，专为老玩家与核心玩家准备，大幅回调甚至提升游戏难度，去除了一系列辅助机制，包括地图、投掷物辅助线、准星和命中反馈等。不过在通过集中资源点鼓励玩家战斗的同时，硬核模式容器数量和爆率并不低，符合玩家对难度与奖励的综合预期。
包括卡牌玩法在内，S19推出的这一系列“狠活”，是想取悦不同层次和取向的玩家。
像硬核模式和指挥官模式，能够承接搜打撤品类不同生态位用户的需求，前者为最核心的那批玩家服务，而后者更强调策略博弈，允许玩家自行寻找适合自己的最优打法。至于衍生的卡牌玩法，能够满足碎片化的场景需求，吸引各路休闲玩家驻足体验。
总体而论，这些玩法诠释对玩家群体实现了分层覆盖的精准内容布局——而暗区所表现出的这种倾向，其实已经持续许久了。
硬核与休闲，可以兼顾
S19的扩圈倾向是对前几个赛季更新思路的继承和延伸。 今年以来，《暗区突围》一边打磨主体搜打撤模式，另一边也按照赛季更新的节奏，持续推出对休闲玩家而言十分友好的新玩法。
单是PVE玩法，暗区就“狠活”频出，例如在S17，推出大战怪物和伪人队友的微恐题材PVE合作玩法“诡雾山谷”；
其实很难说伪人和敌对真人玩家谁更恐怖

items.title: 没别人会像《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》这样做战棋了
items.summary: 9月28日，在第三方通关时间统计网站“How Long to Beat”上，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》终于有了首个“全破”通关纪录，全长120小时。此时距离游戏发售已经过了11天，该网站上其余7条记录也十分接近，只有一位连续

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/3e3c19d31eef3cb235be7fe5daed5fba.appmsg_mw680water
9月28日，在第三方通关时间统计网站“How Long to Beat”上，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》终于有了首个“全破”通关纪录，全长120小时。此时距离游戏发售已经过了11天，该网站上其余7条记录也十分接近，只有一位连续三次跳过了战争篇的玩家，将通关时间压到了74小时，成为唯一一个不满90小时的纪录。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/2bef20065b116014e94424c9021037fb.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/02ac6bc1c11d584e99d499ad1e1ef772.appmsg_mw680water
目前公开的全流程视频长度也和网站上的记录相似
我自己的体验也差不多。游玩近两周、总时长达到30小时后，我才把四条路线之一的迪托利希线推进到第二部“战争篇”。这显然只能算阶段性成果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f1024824f94dca7402daf59df8931b18.appmsg_mw680water
《万缕千丝》给人的第一印象就是一个朴素的“长”——真的应了“万缕千丝”这个标题，也长到恐怕再没另一家公司会像这样来做战棋游戏了。
《万缕千丝》之所以长，首先来自剧情结构。创建自捏主角“救世主”后，玩家很快会得知魔神复活、世界濒临毁灭的坏消息。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f32b330e1beeedc0437b4e199c4d3f55.gif_mw680
顺带一提，光是序章就出现了激光炮大战丧尸巨人的超现实场面
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/87bfd4f8fd26416891fe27dcf8a29395.appmsg_mw680water
还真不是
此时，游戏允许玩家带着仅三人的初始队伍直接进入游戏第三部，在跳过绝大多数故事、出战名额不齐的状态下挑战敌人大军。但这更像一条为战棋老手准备的高难速通挑战：战斗强度高、容错低，还会让玩家错过绝大部分剧情。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/c92e885a68d438fdbab355c52ad95a72.appmsg_mw680water
只靠三名角色想要挑战魔神大军，少不了用到卡位、算刀等技巧
真正承载完整故事的，则是另一条路：借女神之力回到过去，救下四位原本必死的关键角色，并让他们成为同伴。
这条“逆转未来”的主线，按游玩流程又分成第一部和第二部。第一部中，四名角色为了各自的目的前往王城“鞑古席翁”，参加大型斗技比赛“大剑斗祭”。到了第二部“战争篇”，幕后黑手的布局已经完成，几名主角与各自的同伴不得不投身战场，抵抗帝国大军的入侵。能在战争中存活下来的角色，也就改变了自己必死的命运，在第三部成为自创角色“救世主”的助力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/51c2d66f3105c12e68cd2f81a1c195d1.appmsg_mw680water
四条路线在叙事上的差异来自视角切换。每名角色只能看到自己身份和立场所能接触到的部分，玩家也因此在不同路线中看到“大剑斗祭”的不同侧面。
从流程上看，每条路线起始都有一段约两小时的专属序章，用来交代角色身份、经历和参赛动机。以黑衣剑客迪托利希为例，他出海时船只被怪物“海王克托斯”击沉，上岸后又结识了几名新同伴。一行人希望在大剑斗祭中崭露头角，赢得传说中坚不可摧的“鞑古扎战船”，再与海怪一决胜负。
另一位主角凯伊出身村庄，目标则更直接：赢下大剑斗祭，把被关进大牢的父亲赎出来。
由于序章的内容长、战斗多，几名角色很快升到10级，却还停留在成长率最低的初始职业，让我一度有种“是不是亏了”的感觉。但第三部展示的五年后剧情里，“救世主”一行等级已经达到40级，这也让我意识到本作的成长跨度很大，和后面的成长空间相比，前面几级的得失就没有那么让人焦虑了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/c5cb20c0b43381624c041f8ec85932e6.appmsg_mw680water
第三部初始的40级在以往的《火纹》作品中，基本已经是后期或者终盘的等级了
四条路线在叙事上的差异，主要体现在主视角不同：每条线基本只展开当前主角能够接触到的信息。即便四人陆续抵达王城“鞑古席翁”，这种有限视角也没有消失，同一场“大剑斗祭”会在不同路线中呈现出不同侧面；其赛程则让不同路线的角色在固定节点产生交集。
我在一条线里看到没交代清楚的冲突后，会想知道另一条线在同一时间发生了什么。而若想完整了解四条线的故事，少不了将四名角色各自的第一部和第二部全都玩一遍。
剧情之外，游戏还在每段主线之间加入大量生活化玩法。这些战斗外内容原本就是《风花雪月》在战棋之外吸引新玩家的重要部分；到了《万缕千丝》，它们不仅被保留下来，野外探索的比重也明显提高。
大剑斗祭的间隙，玩家可以在鞑古席翁城内请客吃饭、训练、挖角，也可以前往城外的节点式世界地图。本作的地图由棋盘式的节点组成，横跨多个地区，玩家按回合移动推进，逐步解锁新的区域。在这个过程中还能获得招募角色所需的特定素材，或是从商人手里购入强力武器，解锁影响后续剧情的关键外传等等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/b32c567ba54288f56efdff1ebbfb8f68.appmsg_mw680water
该作的大地图庞大而复杂
平心而论，这些“通马桶”环节的确占用了不少时间，一些活动还需要定期回城处理，在城外掐着点跑来跑去时也难免有些焦虑。不过和《风花雪月》相比，本作四线日常流程的差异更加明显。
迪托利希作为战斗狂，其特殊玩法是使用魔剑“安萨拉”寻找潜在强敌并向他们发起挑战。路线约束相对较少，因此游玩相对自由，何时搜索、是否交战、向哪边推进都由玩家决定。加之地图离主城越远，敌人越强、奖励越高，因此我会不断向远端探索，临近时限再回城处理日常。
我朋友对凯伊线的感受则完全不同：几乎一直忙个不停，很少能空出手来出远门。凯伊的大地图玩法是捕捉鸵鸟、马等坐骑，再用野菜等素材喂养并提高属性。为了获得足够的素材，他还需要在资源点种植种子，并定期回来收菜。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/af3cf9535e6c02a6f7cda97e6f11eacb.appmsg_mw680water
游戏中还有一些能力强又稀有的特殊坐骑
这部分还反哺了战棋玩法。
凯伊线捕获的稀有坐骑既能提高对应角色的属性，也能提高其成长率。因此常常变成全员骑兵的配置。
女王赛奥朵拉线又提供了另一套思路。她可以为角色配备军团并释放对应计略，但这一系统只适用于步兵。因此她的养成重点自然落在步兵身上，与凯伊线正好相反。
这些差异让四条路线的日常与养成不至于完全重样；但大剑斗祭的赛程终究要经历四次，于是游戏又加入了跨路线继承，让后续路线在重复环节上“越打越快”。
完成任意一名角色的路线后，玩家就可以带队伍进入第三部，直接和“救世主”一起挑战最终Boss。不过，如果转而开启其他角色路线，就能吃到跨路线继承带来的“红利”。
不同路线都有需要在本线满足条件才能获得的隐藏职业。例如，骑鸵鸟的“飞驼兵”可以转职为“神驼兵”，但这条职业路径需要在凯伊线解锁；其他路线只有继承该要素后，才能使用神驼兵。类似这种隐藏职业，每条路线都有不少。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f570bd6975835f9c9e058e2dcb15b734.appmsg_mw680water
兼具高物防和魔防的隐藏职业“卫士”
除去隐藏职业外，当任意路线的第一部完成后，前一位角色探索过的地图节点，包括可以用来快速移动的马车站点，也会一并继承给后续路线；通用的支线任务也会自动完成。对玩家来说，后续路线的跑图压力会明显减轻，可以把更多时间留给角色养成。
因此，社区也常讨论先走哪条线更合适。
更值得注意的是，《万缕千丝》目前的体量，已经是经历过一次明显缩减后的结果。
除去四条线路的主角外，在游戏中还有着四位明显有着“主角相”的角色：比如神秘商人谭利穆恩的名字出现在不少NPC的对话中，让人能感觉到他也在一点点推进自己的计划；戴猫面具的少女欧露赫露则在一次战斗中展露真容，其面貌与传说中的女神完全一致；武艺超群的“白发鬼”贝特兰每次出场都会成为事件的焦点。
这几位角色的关键剧情有专属的过场动画
这些角色在战场上也都各自拥有专属的“圣焰战技”，与四条路线的主角一样，在剧情中被称为“真焰使”。
发售前的官方采访也提到，该作最初计划设置八名主角，后来因体量过大缩减为四人。
但即使是大幅缩减后的体量，依旧能打个一百小时。
结语
所以，再回看开头“How Long to Beat”的那几条通关记录，这个时长也不难理解了。
《万缕千丝》把四条角色线装进同一个存档，让完整体验的内容量接近四个独立篇章。游戏的确允许玩家跳过部分路线，但面对完整的剧情、隐藏职业和外传内容，想看全的玩家未必舍得走捷径。
我目前只推进到战争篇，暂时没法判断这种长度最终是享受还是负担。但至少“它很大”这一点，现在已经不需要怀疑了。

items.title: 今夜星光灿烂，我们重返未来
items.summary: Vertin, Do you want to be the timekeeper? 《重返未来：1999》的第一次音乐会，开在江浙刚刚入凉的季节。我提早两个小时来到上海体育馆的时候，外头已经下起了雨。 音乐会的名字叫「众

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/767018456ee63e2ea36913bf6e7f70e8.appmsg_mw680water
Vertin,
Do you want to be the timekeeper?
《重返未来：1999》的第一次音乐会，开在江浙刚刚入凉的季节。我提早两个小时来到上海体育馆的时候，外头已经下起了雨。
音乐会的名字叫「众声漫游夜」。因为1999最重要的意象就是带走整个时代的“暴雨”，到了音乐会这天，雨倒成了应景的东西，多少有点debuff变buff的意思。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/8adfb221f335c41134381bff4d164ecc.appmsg_mw680water
通过这种方式拍到雨吧
即便早到了两个小时，已有不少司辰比我来得更早。因为座位在中间，演出开始前，我便一直忙着扮演“无料中转站”的业务：先有一沓纸片从右边传来，“那边的老师给的无料！”我取下一张，把余下的递给左边。过了一会儿，又有一沓从左边传来，附带同样的话。我再取下一张，将余下的递向右边。
至于“那边”究竟是哪边，我们谁也无法深究，只能在此感谢不具名的司辰们分享的无料。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/8dd736490b1613613cd93f8dd37750d8.appmsg_mw680water
谁家好人做的月卡
在这里，也有所有游戏音乐会都会出现的定番：现场抽卡。前排时不时有玩家举起平板电脑，每有一张SP红弩箭从纺车里出现，后排观众席便响起欢呼。偶尔十连全紫，欢呼同样响亮，还夹着笑声。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/11cd6fb09d6854a4352263ee3ffa58fe.appmsg_mw680water
直到晚七点。音乐会准时开始，无料们的旅行暂时停止，应援棒的灯光亮起。接下来是两个小时的音乐会，从游戏最初1.0的音乐开始，共计五个篇章，38首曲目。绵密如雨。
——该怎么描述这场音乐会呢？我想，既然现场的意义就在于“现场”，一切的文字必然都是无力的，假使我真的往这篇文章里插入很多视频片段，恐怕也不如大家上B站自己看玩家们的饭拍。
我还记得散场的时候，和我一起来看同事开玩笑说， 要不你标题这么起吧，“我们二次元也有自己的《汉密尔顿》”。
我知道他是在感慨现场舞美和视觉呈现的“强度”。两个小时里，同一块舞台不断变成别的地方，每到一处，都有视觉和演出方式截然不同的画面——但我还是摇摇头，说感觉那倒也不至于。但这个玩笑到今天还留在我脑海里，是的，好像确实就是这个意思。
太像音乐剧了。尤其是伊索尔德开始唱《门》的时候。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/cb36e90302ecd67c0cfee939a6cd0443.appmsg_mw680water
《门》是1.7版本《今夜星光灿烂》中歌剧演员伊索尔德的角色EP。这首歌可以形容为，唱的是她心里的“小房间”，而在现场，伊索尔德的演员真的被装进了一个透明罩子里。
我听过很多遍录音室版本的《门》，但这次现场的演绎，几乎像是另一首歌。现场的声压给人的感觉是完全不同的。人声的高音和管弦乐迎面而来，先听见声音的部位其实是胸腔，其次才是耳朵。
还有表演。其他演员伸手触碰、纠缠着伊索尔德，仿佛那些始终侵扰她的声音，终于有了形体。坐在钢琴前为她伴奏的，则是卡卡尼亚——她的朋友和……
到了歌曲的高潮，玻璃陡然破碎，两个人隔着破碎后的边界相望。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/54d4b3d6941d380bf7ae1685838a50ee.appmsg_mw680water
真的很歌剧。《今夜星光灿烂》本身也很歌剧，现在我们终于在歌剧舞台上听到真的歌剧演员扮演游戏里的歌剧演员，很绕口，也很美妙。
你看，我费劲说了这么半天，其实还是不如给大家看一段视频切片：
视频来自小红书@长尾
其实我也拍了，但事后发现被第一声“one by one by one”震撼到之后全都拍歪了
所有的舞台，都是这个程度的演绎。
其实我已经不记得歌曲的顺序了，不如想到哪写哪吧。到了《再见，来亚什基》的音乐，台上换了一群穿着苏联时代工装的人，《极夜》的后朋克歌声响起，先是一个人，然后有人加入，最后成了一群人……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/5b150a8ce915adc571e0854927da2f74.appmsg_mw680water
然后是《海燕》。叶甫根尼敬礼，升向高处，身影与纱幕上的飞机重合。他驾驶飞机撞向威胁小镇的敌人。舞台上的短短一瞬，再现了游戏里发生过的死。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/45e8d31a926fae5ff3b168be1b77d0bc.appmsg_mw680water
下一首曲子响起时，飞机成了残骸。向日葵在它四周铺开，歌手坐在上面弹吉他、吹起口哨，
那支口哨也平常得很，仿佛有人在一段工作结束后，随意哼起熟悉的歌。
但只有司辰们知道，一切是为了什么。《再见，来亚什基》的乐章，最后就在这样的画面里结束，观众席安静了一会儿，随即是不息的掌声。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/c566735d7276628c28c3eebe8fe74777.appmsg_mw680water
1999三年多以来的舞台剧，就这样一幕又一幕接着上场，持续了两个小时。《青柑橘》里斯奈德和维尔汀的相遇，《拍硬档》里的粤语歌声和闪片西装，《孤独之歌》里每每露西的镜头，台下传来的惊叹声……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/d7a26b6f5d235d98709d8333ce6e4c5f.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/b248dd8c7c0af639e18103d1c52fcc03.appmsg_mw680water
我会记得《1987宇宙组曲》的星空。合成器与管弦乐缓缓铺开，远旅的吟唱从中浮起，灯光把星点送到观众席。观众们仰望自己头顶的世界，一如库珀花环仰望群星，上世纪的人们，也曾这样仰望。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14488/fc78adacf4846ee606471364e785256e.appmsg_mw680water
我也记得马库斯缓缓越过舞台的那一段。她在大屏幕上从左向右踱步，穿过一幅幅画框，所到之处，灯光依次亮起。
镜头有时给到现场的司辰们，有人笑着，有人还在抹眼泪。
在来到上海体育场之前，我可能从来没想过这次的音乐会的内容会真的做到“全网零差评”。装置与大屏彼此呼应，演员的站位、表演和灯光也都照应着剧情，我几乎挑不出什么毛病。能把题材、年代和音乐风格相隔这么远的游戏内容，一首首串联起来，做成让人记得住的舞台，这场音乐会的舞美内容设计，确实很见功力。
几乎可以说，1999的“文化巡游”这个说法，在这一晚是最贴切的。游戏里的旅行，其实是在漫长的时间里随着大版本更新，一站一站展开；而到了这次的现场，几年的内容被浓缩进两个多小时里。
维也纳的幕布，北方的工厂，沛城的新年，轮番上场的演员、乐手，还有真正立起来的布景，歌剧、摇滚、民乐、迪斯科，坐在同一个座位上，就好像我在地球上空不停拖动着地图，原先分散在不同版本里的声音与画面，此刻密得像一堵墙，迎面推过来。
我恍惚了一整夜，因为台上的年份和我记得的年份并不一致。音乐里的故事可能发生在上个世纪，或者上上个世纪，再听到时，我想起的却是自己两三年前阅读这些文本和画面的那个晚上。
时间是有联觉的。
关于1999，我有一个至今不知道该不该称它为巧合的巧合。2023年，我家人得了一场重病，中间做过两次大手术。第一次做手术的那天是6月1日，1999公测的第二天。那天我在手术室外等了八个小时——很难说是焦急或者担忧吧，就是不知道该做什么好。我下载了这款游戏，推一会儿主线，再来回踱一会儿步。
直到主线里学校的孩子们推门出去。在屏幕外边，手术室的门刚好打开了。
这是整个1.0的剧情里我记得最深的一幕
音乐会这天，孩子们上台合唱第一防线学校校歌（《另一片天空》）的时候，我想，直到时间化为尘埃的那天，我大概也不会忘掉这个画面了。绝对不会。
从未有这样一款游戏刚好让我清楚地记得，玩到某个地方时，我在哪里、在做什么——可能是因为恰好1.2和1.3上线的时候，我又恰好在不同的医院陪床，游戏要过版本，人也是。
抱歉，这些记忆有些私人了。但可能，对于其他观众来说也是这样。
欢快的《走吉歌》响起时，我注意到隔壁排的女孩抹了抹眼泪。舞台上、画面里，角色们在迎接新年，她是不是也想起某次不太愉快的、结束了很久的春节？
三年多时间过去，9的角色们沿着他们的命运继续往前，每一位司辰，也沿着自己的生活走了很久。
演出结束后，我在小红书上看见不少幕后工作人员分享创作的过程：曲目重编，管弦乐录音，乐队合排，歌手、演员、影像和机械装置的配合……司辰们熟悉的曲子，要重新增添修补更多内容，以便适应这个舞台；
在「众声漫游夜」音乐总监的记录里，有一天从下午四点半开始工作，收工已经到了次日早晨七点。
这么大题材跨度的舞美、曲目和表演，同一块舞台在两个小时内不停的变幻，工作人员的压力可想而知。我可以想象，在这个舞台下的座位空着的时候，这些最终令人叫好的片刻，是怎么先在空座位前做一遍，再做一遍。

items.title: 我们从《逃离塔科夫》官方弄来些福利，人人有份
items.summary: 当一款“斯拉夫游戏”开始学运营 今天（10月6日），“所有搜打撤游戏的严父”《逃离塔科夫》就将推出围绕PVE模式的大型更新，包含新的“转生”系统和若干游戏性改进。 正值黄金周尾声，我们也在与开发商BattleState

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/a6174533e102368fcb113ca1505467e3.appmsg_mw680water
当一款“斯拉夫游戏”开始学运营
今天（10月6日），“所有搜打撤游戏的严父”《逃离塔科夫》就将推出围绕PVE模式的大型更新，包含新的“转生”系统和若干游戏性改进。
正值黄金周尾声，我们也在与开发商BattleState Games工作室交流过后，从他们那儿为大家筹措到一份PVE模式限定的开荒物资：
新版本上线后，只要在塔科夫官网或塔科夫客户端的兑换码界面，输入游研社的英文名“YYSTV”，即可通过游戏内邮件领取一份完整装备包，包含完整的耳机、头盔、弹挂甲、背包，一把HK416突击步枪，以及120发高穿弹药。 希望能给各位玩家的新版本体验带来一些小帮助。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/8ce77219d705ca1f1f6c39fe82cf53c4.appmsg_mw680water
注意兑换码有效期为两周
事实上，这趟合作主要是由BattleState提起的：他们不希望中国的玩家们错过游戏福利，也愿意通过《逃离塔科夫》，让更多海外玩家认识中国的玩家同好们。
今年以来，BSG和塔科夫对中国市场的关注度与日俱增——都离不开这样主动的沟通。游戏官方跟国内的社区、媒体与KOL积极建联，还抽空来了8月份的ChinaJoy。
那是塔科夫第一次参加国内游戏展会，取得了相当不错的反响，展台前每天都是人山人海。
从巨大的坦克模型到身着战术装备的Coser，塔科夫为CJ贡献了全场最硬核的展台，任何一位路过的军迷或射击游戏爱好者，都会被这里硬控半天。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/66e6ab1997a61f52b15122f7b2c3a968.appmsg_mw680water
CJ塔科夫展台现场，排队观众堵得水泄不通
对无数从全国各地赶到上海的塔科夫玩家而言，CJ也贡献了类似“塔科夫Only”展的友好氛围，现场粉丝都抢着去找尼基塔合影留念，留下了无数至今还在中文社区流传的名场面。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/4d6d2fff306df92c24c11c5ae9d9a88d.appmsg_mw680water
“自我批评”
这种情绪的传递是双向的——你能看到包括制作人Nikita在内的开发团队，也对中国玩家的热情留下了深刻的印象。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/bb9e8ec5aeba1f707378c9b2bc2a9845.appmsg_mw680water
CJ结束后尼基塔发推感谢中国粉丝支持
要知道的是，在此之前， 《逃离塔科夫》常被称为“典型的斯拉夫游戏”——意思是压根不懂运营。
这事儿可以从尼基塔为什么会被称作“千古罪人”说起。
在社区定义中，“斯拉夫游戏”往往拥有市面上找不到竞品的硬核玩法内容，但在需要软下来的运营层面总是出问题，譬如弱新手引导、每次更新都会出现的BUG或网络稳定性问题，以及宛如苏联后期一般的游戏内经济系统。我在去年的1.0正式版评测中也提到，是一系列运营层面的问题，严重拖累了《逃离塔科夫》登陆Steam平台后的好评率。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/fd8ca6efe0f4d5f1195331177e1d9eb6.appmsg_mw680water
就像这个高亮提示任务物品在附近的准星，居然是今年才搓出来的
同时制作人尼基塔也带点俄罗斯人的真性情，总是习惯在社交媒体上发表意见，还会跟部分言辞激烈的玩家对线，久而久之他也变成了塔科夫各类运营问题的“背锅侠”。
但从正式服上线第一年的表现来看， 目前的塔科夫反倒变成了“斯拉夫游戏”难兄难弟中最想上进的那个 ：
在线下，尼基塔同中国玩家积极互动、乐呵整活的表现简直像尊弥勒佛；
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/983bf31e37ccaaa34f9eb4920dbaab1d.gif_mw680
有活他是真给你整，图源B站@一只头比较大的野鸽
在线上，他在社媒平台和官方直播中给塔科夫未来更新画的饼，也都在逐步兑现。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/1b195ba6f63a00436a2cdc76e2c6ace3.appmsg_mw680water
2026年底塔科夫的更新路线图
可以说 塔科夫真的想学会如何搞运营。 也许它只是在走一些已由其他厂商验证过的老路，但对“斯拉夫游戏”而言，这些老路反而变成了让玩家们叫好的先进经验。
就比如，塔科夫通过引入赛季制、通行证和“自愿删档”的转生机制，缓解了搜打撤游戏的一大核心痛点：玩家资产的无限制膨胀，对游戏平衡性与乐趣的影响。
在主流的PVP搜打撤环境下，资产膨胀的核心玩家总是碾压休闲玩家。这天经地义，但是因为搜打撤有死亡惩罚和“赢家通吃”的设计，挫败感较强，难免会劝退萌新、加剧游戏环境内卷。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/ed27f138814a66adc6bfe60a522016a9.appmsg_mw680water
我又要把这张图搬出来了
而塔科夫针对资产膨胀的唯一解决方案就是删档（wipe）。资产和进度全盘清零，对任何玩家而言都无异于莫大的痛苦，却也是一种最简单粗暴的、维系游戏平衡和乐趣的方式。
据我所知，业界的绝大多数搜打撤后辈都不敢采用删档设计，因此只能靠对物资产出与爆率的严格限制，以及极其复杂的匹配系统，降低贫富差距的负面影响。以硬核著称的塔科夫，固然也不可能消除删档带来的痛苦。
但它可以将选择删档的权利交付给玩家，并且为自愿选择痛苦的玩家提供永久性补偿。
目前塔科夫开放了三种并行的游戏模式，正式版上线带来了永不删档的PVP和PVE模式，而今年8月的更新又开放了PVP赛季服（PVPS）。
赛季服采取“硬性删档”，于每个赛季初清零进度。按尼基塔的设想，为了规避赛季体验的重复感，除例行内容更新外，每个赛季都会带来一批独特的全局效果和个人角色特质。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/95eed9780b0beb1ef49880bfc682f350.appmsg
全局效果对所有玩家生效
这个角色特质尤为有趣，为新档开荒带来了很大的变数。玩家要在创建赛季角色时选择一批正面或负面修正，每项修正都有对应点数，只有剩余点数大于等于0时才能完成角色创建。在第一赛季，玩家开局就能点出许多人的终极游戏目标——3*4安全箱，只是为此需要付出极大的代价，比如相较其他玩家而言更容易饥饿口渴、出血骨折等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/62ac55677a357b42c9ca6eff8135b03e.appmsg_mw680water
有点像《僵尸毁灭工程》
和赛季制一并更新的还有通行证——这对于塔科夫而言也算是前所未有的新鲜事物。
玩家们要在对局中搜集特定的文件以提升通行证等级，换取如限定外观、装备等奖励。像第一赛季的最终奖励，便是塔科夫实装的首款国产枪械——QBZ-191突击步枪在所有模式/服务器下的购买权限。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14487/763fae179ba612af5b186817d29905ce.appmsg_mw680water
也算某种递交给国内社区的“投名状”
通行证机制并非赛季服限定，其奖励和所需文件在PVP和PVE均可获取，只是文件存在每日获取上限，而PVP赛季服上限最高。
后续更新中，塔科夫也在陆续完善赛季制设计，加快养成过程，降低获取通行证奖励的难度，例如在9月的一次更新中，实装了新的每日任务机制，完成后会发放通行证文件奖励。
每日任务一般不会设计得太难
理论上，每个赛季的稳定内容更新、随机修正效果，以及通行证的限定奖励，能为坚持硬性删档的赛季服带来持续的新意和趣味性，维持PVP模式的日活——这套赛季制曾在《暗黑破坏神》和《流放之路》等PVE刷子游戏上得到成功验证，在塔科夫也未尝不能应验。
同时对于PVP永久服，虽然没有硬性删档，但设计有 转生系统（Prestige） ，更像一种“软性删档”。任何完成了转生任务链的玩家都可以转生，重置任务进度和绝大部分资产，换取限定装饰品或近战武器奖励，以及在主线任务中重新做选择、攻略其他结局的机会。
“自愿删档”的朴素原则，创造了人人都能长久享受的搜打撤生态。核心玩家能够选择爆肝赛季服和永久服多周目，争取作为“高手证明”的限定外观。而休闲玩家可以在永久服自由享受囤积的乐趣，在玩腻的时候再主动选择删档。
转生奖励也是永久保留
纵观整个撤离射击品类，其实也就只有塔科夫把删档和类似多周目的设计跑得最顺。
因为在长达近10年的删档测试中，塔科夫积累了量大管饱还足够有趣的PVE内容，包含需要数百个小时完成的多结局主线与支线任务树，甚至具备多周目的重玩价值。删档测试时期也有不少老玩家说过：塔科夫在刚开档时的“村口械斗”永远是最好玩的。

items.title: 这款游戏，妈祖来了也得说声福建人能飞
items.summary: 当你的家乡成为《QQ飞车》里的下一站 今年年初，我去了福建旅游，刚好赶上当地“送王船“的时节。 这项闽南沿海的民俗活动里，当地人会先花一两个月时间制作精美的巨大木船，然后举办盛大的仪式，把它送到海边点燃，以此祈求顺遂平安

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/9e9b0b012418a5a5ef5105098369259e.appmsg_mw680water
当你的家乡成为《QQ飞车》里的下一站
今年年初，我去了福建旅游，刚好赶上当地“送王船“的时节。
这项闽南沿海的民俗活动里，当地人会先花一两个月时间制作精美的巨大木船，然后举办盛大的仪式，把它送到海边点燃，以此祈求顺遂平安。漫天火光，属实给外地人带来了一场文化冲击。
相比仪式上的“传统”，让我印象深刻的还有当地年轻人对传统的热衷与再创作。
在泉州、漳州等城市的众多书店中，能看到不少与当地民风民俗相关的作品，年轻人们通过漫画、杂志等形式，参与了本土文化的传承和再创作。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/6676cf22d2e4f66da9806af862dff6b5.appmsg_mw680water
漳州的一处文化空间，出现了数量惊人的分享活动海报
于是旅行结束后，我脑海里的福建有了更鲜明的形象：其实直到现代，那些流传了千百年的文化传统，依然不断焕发着活力，真切地存在于老厝与高楼之间。
而如今，玩家也可以用另一种数字化的方式，在游戏里体验福建文化的生命力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/92306bd9b048e8be55e98c29c313ca71.appmsg_mw680water
“三分天注定，七分靠打拼”，福建人常用《爱拼才会赢》这首在本土流传甚广的闽南语金曲来描述自己的精神气质。
就在前不久，《QQ飞车》在福建省文旅的支持下，推出《QQ飞车》“飞跃华夏”·清新福建版本——
《QQ飞车》与福建，恰好在“敢拼会赢”这一点上产生了共鸣。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/a8c4746817557e019418f3ef92ba6f85.appmsg_mw680water
今年其实已经是《QQ飞车》“飞跃华夏”文旅联动的第七年了。过去的每一年里，这项计划都与各地的文旅厅合作，带着玩家一路走遍了祖国的大江南北。
而这次的福建站，背后既有省文旅厅作为指导，也有一次次实践积累的不少成功经验。
比如，接地气的好活就没有缺席。
飞车手游官方制作的宣传素材，玩了“金钱豹”的梗，用上世纪流行的闽南歌碟片的形式，打造了一支MTV样式的“宣传片”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/f63ddc3b5bfe9d49ebadcb05f21332f8.gif_mw680
看着这个画面，脑子里已经响起“共虾米”了
评论区里，你能看到很多IP福建的玩家纷纷称赞，甚至不少人表示，自己小时候天天看，还真的能跟着唱下来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/769c7e056cb127cceca4ffdb8c65439d.appmsg_mw680water
整活归整活，严肃地说，把文旅联动的这一站定在福建，其实对策划来说并不是一件容易的事。
八山一水一分田的福建，孕育了多样的人文地貌，“百里不同音，十里不同俗”是常见现象。如何让不同区域的福建人都能找到属于自己的记忆、让其他地区的玩家全面看到福建丰富多彩的文化？要用一场联动的体量来呈现，属实是不小的挑战。
而这次联动中，《QQ飞车》选择用肉眼可见的“拼”带来了相当高的内容规格，从赛道设计到玩法细节，都还原了最地道的闽味。
首先在赛道和场景这个每年的重头戏上，《QQ飞车》这次一口气还原了来自闽地四方的四道风景线。
冲过起跑线，首先能看到的，就是代表闽北山地茶文化的武夷茶山；几个跳板过弯后，便能穿行在展现闽都文化底蕴的三坊七巷；

https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/f2120bd554718ae159a4aab53325efd8.appmsg_mw680water
紧随其后的，是一栋栋承载闽西客家记忆的永定土楼，赛车在其中飞转腾挪的视觉效果尤为震撼；
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/74f5d7527a40b0f27c38176036c2a5ed.gif_mw680
而在最能代表闽南海运文化的刺桐港，穿过具象化的海上丝路和古代商船后，这趟飞跃山海的福建之旅，最终在多元文化交汇的鼓浪屿落幕。
四段核心场景，就这样串起了福建从山林到海港的不同景观，也轻巧地连接起了闽地从古至今的厚重文化。
对于那些在现实中领略过福建好山好水的玩家来说，真产生了一种身临其境、飞翻其上之感。

此外，《QQ飞车》也在游戏里的各种细节处都融入了对非遗文化的传承，并且做出了非常地道而深入的考证。
例如这次联动的皮肤套装就不止一款。首先是火遍了大江南北的闽南蟳埔女簪花造型，在活动早期宣传阶段，玩家对此的呼声就很高。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14484/91983dc0dc7dfa6639b1fd7e8c13f1a6.appmsg_mw680water
而这款「绯花簪月」的簪花套装，不仅服装融入了传统汉服中云肩、马面裙的元素，在主题色上更是选用了当地传统簪花常用的红色调，可以看出设计上确实很下功夫。
除此之外，《QQ飞车》还考证到了福州女性头戴三柄刀簪的传统造型，每种套装都复原得相当好看。
更难得的是，这次联动中，《QQ飞车》还进一步呈现出了当代福建人的精神面貌。最具代表性的呈现，莫过于联动A车的设计。
「一帆风顺」融入了古代商船的设计元素，同时致敬了送王船的非遗民俗，承载着顺风顺水、祈福安康的美好寓意；
「向海而歌」则用颇富未来感的半透车体来代表海洋文化，也通过海浪构造以及取材自“平潭蓝眼泪”的喷焰特效，带上了几分水墨国画的意境。
这两款车型的设计，既带有传统的古意，又不失开拓向前的锋芒，这两款A车因此得到了玩家的一致好评。
而通过赛道彩蛋宝箱的设计，《QQ飞车》也将福建人的拼搏精神融入到了游戏体验中。
本次联动赛道中，四道“闽”字机关分别藏在木筏、荷叶等四处不寻常的位置上，只要玩家敢飞出赛道，就能打开隐藏传送门，吃到藏在船头的宝箱。
对文旅联动来说，单纯地还原地标、融入非遗文化，是最容易想到的一种方式。而《QQ飞车》这次的联动，则是在这样的基础上，捕捉到了福建人身上的精神气质和竞速游戏内核的契合之处。
能唤起精神共鸣的文化表达，也出现在了落地厦门的《QQ飞车》手游亚洲杯总决赛上。
这场赛事除了让玩家看到顶尖选手之间的竞速对决，还带来了由泉州非遗木雕大师参与设计制作的“亚洲之翼”冠军奖杯，而奖杯获得者，本届亚洲杯冠军恰好是来自中国台湾的选手Walker，这似乎也算是一种奇妙的冠军之缘。
传统手艺与电竞荣誉在这里相遇，一件承载速度与胜利的奖杯，成为了福建文化向更多玩家展示的新载体。
这其实也是“清新福建”版本的一个缩影：《QQ飞车》所做的，除了还原，更是在寻找地方文化与竞速精神之间真正的连接点。
如今的文旅联动的赛道上，这样的深度表达是很少见的。
但也恰恰是因为《QQ飞车》把文创联动做到了这种程度，可以看到不少福建玩家对游戏呈现感到很亲切，甚至萌发了自豪感和浓浓的乡情。在评论区里，他们纷纷认领了自己的“家乡元素”。
还有不少IP福建的网友，在评论里搭起了楼，表示要在活动上线当天组团回游。
对于外地玩家来说，这些内容带来的则是另一种体验：原本分散在福建各地的风景和文化，被压缩进了一场游戏里的“福建之旅”。因此，一些人在体验过联动内容后，动起了去福建旅游一趟的念头。
来自玩家的热烈反响，足以说明这次的联动，准确地把握住了福建文化的生命力。
不过，在游戏里还原了“清新福建”后，《QQ飞车》依然不满足。
